words.tr: v. 逐步渗透；逐渐灌输
words.ex: Parents try to instill good habits in their children.
words.ex_cn: 父母试图在孩子身上培养良好的习惯。
words.en: To instill something in someone means to gradually but firmly establish an idea or attitude in their mind.

words.ex: The teacher instructed the students to open their books.
words.ex_cn: 老师指示学生打开书。
words.en: To instruct someone means to tell or teach them to do something, especially in a formal or official way.

words.ex: The teacher will enlighten the students about the truth.
words.ex_cn: 老师将向学生们阐明真相。
words.en: To enlighten someone means to give them more knowledge and greater understanding about something.

words.ex: Good teachers edify their students with wisdom.
words.ex_cn: 好老师用智慧启发学生。
words.en: To edify someone means to improve their mind or character by teaching them something.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.tr:
adj. 直接的；
v. 指导；指示；
words.ex: He gave a direct answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了直接的答案。
words.en: If you direct something at a particular thing, you aim or point it at that thing.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

chapters.name: 按学科分类 Word List 18 物理

words.tr: adj. 兼容的；可和谐共存的；
words.ex: This printer is compatible with my computer.
words.ex_cn: 这个打印机与我的电脑兼容。
words.en: If things, for example, systems, ideas, and beliefs, are compatible, they work well together or can exist together successfully.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: The boundless sky made her feel free.
words.ex_cn: 无边无际的天空让她感到自由。
words.en: If you describe something as boundless, you mean that it has no limits or seems to be without limits.

words.ex: The desert seems endless.
words.ex_cn: 这片沙漠看起来无穷无尽。
words.en: If you say that something is endless, you mean that it is very large or lasts for a very long time, and it seems as if it will never stop.

words.ex: The team showed cohesive behavior during the project.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队在项目期间表现出有凝聚力的行为。
words.en: If something is cohesive, it consists of parts that fit together well and form a united whole.

words.ex: The line is horizontal on the graph.
words.ex_cn: 这条线在图上是水平的。
words.en: Parallel to the plane of the horizon; at right angles to the vertical.

words.ex: The bulk of the students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 大部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: The bulk of something is most of it. The bulk of something is its size, especially when it is very large.

words.tr:
n. 边；边缘；帽边
v. （装）满；（使）溢出
words.ex: The cup is full to the brim.
words.ex_cn: 杯子装得满满的。
words.en: The top edge of a container or the projecting edge of a hat.

words.ex: The edge of the table is sharp.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的边缘很锋利。
words.en: The edge of something is the place or line where it stops, or the part of it that is furthest from the middle.

words.ex: He always keeps his garden trim and neat.
words.ex_cn: 他总是把花园打理得整洁有序。
words.en: To trim something means to make it tidier or more level by cutting a small amount off it.

words.ex: The country is on the brink of war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正处于战争的边缘。
words.en: If you are on the brink of something, you are about to do it or experience it.

words.tr:
n. 成分；
adj. 构成的；
words.ex: Sugar is a constituent of soda.
words.ex_cn: 糖是苏打水的一种成分。
words.en: A constituent is a part of a whole. In politics, a constituent is a person who is represented by an elected official.

words.ex: The dimension of the box is 10 cm by 5 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的尺寸是10厘米乘5厘米。
words.en: A dimension is a measurement of something in a particular direction, or the scope or scale of something.

words.ex: The rubber band shows great elasticity when stretched.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋被拉伸时表现出很大的弹性。
words.en: The ability of an object or material to resume its normal shape after being stretched or compressed.

words.ex: The team's cohesion helped them win the match.
words.ex_cn: 团队的凝聚力帮助他们赢得了比赛。
words.en: Cohesion refers to the action or fact of forming a united whole, especially in the context of a group of people or the parts of a substance.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.ex: The gravity of Earth pulls objects down.
words.ex_cn: 地球的重力把物体往下拉。
words.en: Gravity is the force that causes things to fall towards the Earth or towards any other physical body having mass.

words.ex: The new law gave impetus to environmental protection.
words.ex_cn: 新法律为环境保护提供了推动力。
words.en: Something that gives a process impetus or an impetus makes it happen or progress more quickly.

words.tr:
n. 释放；发布；
v. 释放；发布；
words.ex: The release of the prisoner made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的释放让每个人都高兴。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or to allow it to be free, or to make something available to the public.

words.ex: The car decelerate when it sees the red light.
words.ex_cn: 当汽车看到红灯时，它减速了。
words.en: If a vehicle or machine decelerates or if you decelerate it, it slows down.

words.tr:
v. 加速（坏事的发生）
n. 沉淀物；冷凝物
adj. 轻率的；仓促的
words.ex: The scandal precipitated the politician's resignation.
words.ex_cn: 这起丑闻加速了这位政治家的辞职。
words.en: To cause something to happen suddenly or unexpectedly; to cause a substance to be deposited in solid form from a solution.

words.ex: He wants to expedite the process.
words.ex_cn: 他想加快这个过程。
words.en: To expedite something means to make it happen or be done more quickly.

words.tr:
v. 颤抖；颤动；发抖
n. 颤抖
words.ex: The leaf quivers in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在风中颤抖。
words.en: To shake or tremble with a slight rapid motion; a case for carrying arrows.

words.ex: She stored jam in a glass jar.
words.ex_cn: 她把果酱存放在一个玻璃罐里。
words.en: A jar is a glass or clay container with a wide opening at the top and a lid, used especially for storing food.

words.ex: The phone shows a small vibration when it rings.
words.ex_cn: 手机响时会轻微震动。
words.en: A vibration is a continuous slight shaking movement.

words.tr:
v. 放电；放出；
n. 排放；
words.ex: The battery will discharge if left unused for a long time.
words.ex_cn: 如果长时间不使用，电池会放电。
words.en: If someone is discharged from a hospital, prison, or the armed forces, they are officially allowed to leave, or told that they must leave. If something is discharged from inside a place, it comes out.

words.ex: The sweater shrinks in hot water.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在热水中会收缩。
words.en: If something shrinks or you shrink it, it becomes smaller.

words.tr:
v. 弥漫；
adj. 分散的；
words.ex: Smoke began to diffuse through the room.
words.ex_cn: 烟开始弥漫在整个房间里。
words.en: If something such as knowledge or information is diffused, or if it diffuses, it is made known over a wide area or to a lot of people.

words.ex: The lamp emits a soft light.
words.ex_cn: 灯发出柔和的光。
words.en: To emit means to send out something such as light, heat, sound, gas, etc.

words.tr: v. 蒸发；排出；为人所知；发生
words.ex: Water transpires from the leaves in hot weather.
words.ex_cn: 水在炎热的天气中从叶子中蒸发。
words.en: If it transpires that something has happened, this previously secret or unknown fact becomes known.

words.ex: Five apples constitute a basket.
words.ex_cn: 五个苹果构成一篮子。
words.en: If something constitutes a particular thing, it can be regarded as being that thing.

words.ex: He reject the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作邀请。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.tr: v. 散发；发射（光或热）；辐射
words.ex: The sun radiates heat and light.
words.ex_cn: 太阳散发出热量和光。
words.en: To send out rays or waves, especially of light or heat; to spread out from a central point.

words.ex: Water is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom in a molecule.
words.ex_cn: 水由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成一个分子。
words.en: A molecule is the smallest particle in a chemical element or compound that has the chemical properties of that element or compound. Molecules are made up of atoms that are held together by chemical bonds.

words.ex: The ion moves quickly in the water.
words.ex_cn: 这个离子在水中快速移动。
words.en: An ion is an atom or molecule with a net electric charge due to the loss or gain of one or more electrons.

words.ex: The electron moves around the nucleus.
words.ex_cn: 电子围绕原子核运动。
words.en: An electron is a tiny particle with a negative charge that is found in all atoms and plays a key role in electricity.

words.ex: The neutron has no electric charge.
words.ex_cn: 中子不带电荷。
words.en: A neutron is a subatomic particle found in the nucleus of every atom except that of simple hydrogen. It has no electric charge and a mass slightly greater than that of a proton.

words.ex: The nucleus of the team is the captain.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队的核心是队长。
words.en: The central and most important part of an object, movement, or group, forming the basis for its activity and growth.

words.ex: A proton has a positive charge.
words.ex_cn: 质子带正电。
words.en: A proton is a subatomic particle found in the nucleus of every atom. The particle has a positive electrical charge, equal and opposite to that of the electron.

words.ex: The atom is the smallest part of matter.
words.ex_cn: 原子是物质的最小单位。
words.en: An atom is the smallest unit of ordinary matter that forms a chemical element. Every solid, liquid, gas, and plasma is composed of neutral or ionized atoms.

words.ex: This plant produces electricity using nuclear power.
words.ex_cn: 这座电厂使用核能发电。
words.en: relating to the nucleus of an atom, or to the energy produced when the nucleus of an atom is split or joined with another nucleus

words.ex: He likes to study physics in school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在学校学习物理。
words.en: Physics is the scientific study of matter, energy, force, and motion, and how they relate to each other.

words.ex: The fusion of music and technology creates new sounds.
words.ex_cn: 音乐与技术的融合创造了新的声音。
words.en: The process or result of joining two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.tr:
v. 使融解；解冻；变缓和
n. 融雪
words.ex: The ice begins to thaw in spring.
words.ex_cn: 冰在春天开始融化。
words.en: If ice, snow, or something else that is frozen thaws, it melts. A thaw is a period of warmer weather when snow and ice melt, usually at the end of winter.

words.ex: The water freezes at zero centigrade.
words.ex_cn: 水在零摄氏度时结冰。
words.en: Centigrade is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees.

words.tr:
n. 凝块；泥团；密集的一群
v. 凝结成块
words.ex: The blood began to clot after the cut.
words.ex_cn: 伤口流血后开始凝固。
words.en: A clot is a sticky lump that forms when blood dries up or becomes thick. If blood clots, it becomes thick and forms a lump.

words.tr:
v. （使）升华；使净化
adj. 升华的；纯化的
words.ex: He tries to sublimate his anger into art.
words.ex_cn: 他试图把愤怒升华成艺术。
words.en: To sublimate means to transform something, especially a strong emotion or desire, into a more positive or acceptable form, often through a process of refinement or elevation.

words.ex: The distillation of water removes impurities.
words.ex_cn: 水的蒸馏过程可以去除杂质。
words.en: The process of purifying a liquid by heating it until it becomes a vapor and then cooling the vapor to collect the purified liquid.

words.ex: The room was in chaos after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对之后，房间一片混乱。
words.en: A state of complete disorder and confusion.

words.tr:
n. 杂乱；混乱
v. 弄乱
words.ex: The table is full of clutter.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上堆满了杂物。
words.en: If things or people clutter a place, they fill it in an untidy way.

words.ex: The two kids stayed in equilibrium on the seesaw.
words.ex_cn: 两个孩子在跷跷板上保持了平衡。
words.en: A state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced.

words.ex: The density of water is 1 gram per cubic centimeter.
words.ex_cn: 水的密度是每立方厘米1克。
words.en: Density is a measure of how much mass is contained in a given unit volume of a substance.

words.tr:
n. 液体；
adj. 液态的；
words.ex: Water is a common liquid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的液体。
words.en: A liquid is a substance which is not solid but which flows and can be poured, for example water.

words.tr:
v. 稀释
adj. 经稀释的
words.ex: He dilutes the juice with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水稀释果汁。
words.en: To dilute a liquid means to make it thinner or weaker by adding water or another liquid to it.

words.ex: The sun can dehydrate your skin quickly.
words.ex_cn: 太阳会很快使你的皮肤脱水。
words.en: To dehydrate something means to remove all the water from it, often in order to preserve it. If you dehydrate, you lose too much water from your body, usually because of illness or extreme heat.

words.ex: The ball rolled down the declivity.
words.ex_cn: 球滚下了斜坡。
words.en: A declivity is a downward slope or bend of a surface, especially of the ground.

words.ex: The beer left foam on the top of the glass.
words.ex_cn: 啤酒在杯子顶部留下了一层泡沫。
words.en: Foam is a mass of small bubbles that are formed in or on a liquid.

words.ex: The room has good ventilation through the windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间通过窗户有良好的通风。
words.en: The provision of fresh air to a room, building, etc., or the system that does this.

words.ex: The sun makes the puddle evaporate quickly.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使水坑很快蒸发。
words.en: If a liquid evaporates, or if something evaporates it, it changes from a liquid state to a gas, because its temperature has increased.

words.ex: Water evaporation happens when the sun heats the lake.
words.ex_cn: 当太阳加热湖泊时，水就会蒸发。
words.en: Evaporation is the process by which a liquid turns into a gas.

words.ex: He is learning thermodynamics in physics class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在物理课上学习热力学。
words.en: Thermodynamics is the branch of physical science that deals with the relations between heat and other forms of energy (such as mechanical, electrical, or chemical energy), and, by extension, of the relationships between all forms of energy.

words.ex: There is friction between the two neighbors over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居因为篱笆问题产生了不和。
words.en: The resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another.

words.ex: The attrition between the two rocks caused sparks.
words.ex_cn: 两块岩石之间的摩擦产生了火花。
words.en: Attrition refers to the process of reducing something's strength or effectiveness through sustained attack or pressure, or the gradual reduction in the number of employees in an organization by retirement, resignation, or death.

words.tr:
v. 摩擦；擦痛；惹怒
n. 擦伤；激怒
words.ex: His socks chafe his ankles.
words.ex_cn: 他的袜子磨得脚踝疼。
words.en: If skin chafes, it becomes sore because something is rubbing against it; to feel impatient or irritated.

words.ex: The bridge collapsed due to resonance from the wind.
words.ex_cn: 桥梁因风引起的共振而坍塌。
words.en: Resonance is the quality in a sound of being deep, full, and reverberating.

words.tr:
n. 回声；
v. 回响；
words.ex: The echo came back from the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 回声从山上反弹回来。
words.en: An echo is a sound which is caused by a noise being reflected off a surface such as a wall.

words.tr:
n. 超音波学
n. 超声波；“ultrasonic”的复数
words.ex: The doctor used ultrasonics to check the baby's health.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用超声波检查婴儿的健康状况。
words.en: The science and application of ultrasonic sound waves, especially in medical imaging and diagnostics.

words.ex: The submarine uses sonar to find objects underwater.
words.ex_cn: 潜艇使用声呐来发现水下的物体。
words.en: Sonar is a system for detecting objects under water by emitting sound pulses and detecting or measuring their return after being reflected.

words.ex: The room has good acoustic properties.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有良好的声音效果。
words.en: Relating to sound or the sense of hearing.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.ex: The town lost electricity during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间，这个城镇停电了。
words.en: A form of energy resulting from the existence of charged particles (such as electrons or protons), either statically as an accumulation of charge or dynamically as a current.

words.ex: The electromagnet pulls metal objects when it is turned on.
words.ex_cn: 当电磁铁通电时，它会吸起金属物体。
words.en: An electromagnet is a type of magnet in which the magnetic field is produced by an electric current. The magnetic field disappears when the current is turned off.

words.ex: He is learning electromagnetism in physics class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在物理课上学习电磁学。
words.en: Electromagnetism is a branch of physics involving the study of the electromagnetic force, a type of physical interaction that occurs between electrically charged particles.

words.ex: He uses an electronic book to read.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子书来阅读。
words.en: Electronic means relating to devices or systems that operate by controlling the flow of electrons, especially in a vacuum, gas, or semiconductor.

words.ex: He fixed the broken electronics with a small tool.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个小工具修好了坏掉的电子器件。
words.en: The branch of physics and technology concerned with the design of circuits using transistors and microchips, and with the behavior and movement of electrons in a semiconductor, conductor, vacuum, or gas.

words.ex: The guitar amplifier makes the sound louder.
words.ex_cn: 吉他放大器让声音变大。
words.en: An amplifier is an electronic device that increases the strength of electrical signals, especially sound signals.

words.ex: The remote needs a new battery.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器需要新电池。
words.en: A battery is a device that produces electricity to provide power for radios, cars, toys, etc.

words.tr:
n. 芯片；
v. 削成碎片；碎裂；
words.ex: The computer chip is very small.
words.ex_cn: 计算机芯片非常小。
words.en: A chip is a small piece which has been broken off something larger, or a small piece of silicon used to make computer parts.

words.ex: The conductor raised his baton to start the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 指挥举起指挥棒，开始演奏交响乐。
words.en: A conductor is a person who directs the performance of an orchestra or choir, or a substance that allows heat or electricity to pass through it.

words.tr: n. 隔热（或绝缘、隔音等的）材料（或装置）；
words.ex: Glass is a good insulator for heat.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃是良好的隔热材料。
words.en: An insulator is a material or device that prevents or reduces the passage of heat, electricity, or sound.

words.ex: The magnet picks up the iron nail.
words.ex_cn: 磁铁吸起了铁钉。
words.en: A magnet is a piece of iron or other material which attracts iron or steel towards it.

words.ex: The magnet shows strong magnetism.
words.ex_cn: 这个磁铁显示出很强的磁性。
words.en: Magnetism is a physical phenomenon produced by the motion of electric charge, resulting in attractive and repulsive forces between objects.

words.ex: He works in a factory that makes semiconductors.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家生产半导体的工厂工作。
words.en: A semiconductor is a substance that can conduct electricity under some conditions but not others, making it a good medium for the control of electrical current.

words.tr: n. 晶体管；晶体管收音机
words.ex: The radio uses a small transistor.
words.ex_cn: 这个收音机使用了一个小晶体管。
words.en: A transistor is a semiconductor device used to amplify or switch electronic signals and electrical power.

words.tr: n. 紫外线辐射；紫外光；
words.ex: The ultraviolet from the sun can hurt your skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的紫外线会伤害你的皮肤。
words.en: Ultraviolet light or radiation has a wavelength shorter than that of visible light but longer than X-rays.

words.ex: She heated the food in the microwave.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在微波炉里加热。
words.en: A microwave is a type of oven that cooks or heats food very quickly by using electromagnetic waves rather than heat.

words.tr: n. 运作方式；力学；“mechanic”的复数；
words.ex: The mechanics of this machine are simple to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运作方式很简单易懂。
words.en: Mechanics is the branch of physics that deals with the action of forces on bodies and with motion, comprised of kinetics, statics, and kinematics.

words.ex: The apple fell because of gravitation.
words.ex_cn: 苹果掉下来是因为重力。
words.en: Gravitation is the force of attraction that exists between any two masses, any two bodies, any two particles. It is the force that pulls objects towards each other.

words.ex: The pendulum shows a smooth oscillation.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆表现出平稳的振荡。
words.en: Oscillation is the process of moving back and forth or up and down in a regular rhythm.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.ex: The car will accelerate when you press the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当你踩油门时，汽车会加速。
words.en: To accelerate means to start to go faster or to make something start to go faster.

words.ex: The car's acceleration increased when the driver pressed the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当司机踩油门时，汽车的加速度增加了。
words.en: Acceleration is the rate at which a car or other vehicle can increase its speed, often measured in the time it takes to go from 0 to 60 miles per hour.

words.ex: The glass is transparent.
words.ex_cn: 这玻璃是透明的。
words.en: If something is transparent, you can see through it.

words.tr: adj. 不透明的；难懂的；晦涩的
words.ex: The glass is opaque, so I cannot see through it.
words.ex_cn: 这扇玻璃是不透明的，所以我看不到它后面的东西。
words.en: If an object or substance is opaque, you cannot see through it.

words.ex: The glass is translucent, so you can see light through it.
words.ex_cn: 这种玻璃是半透明的，所以你能看到光透过它。
words.en: If a material or substance is translucent, it is almost transparent, allowing some light to pass through it but not detailed shapes.

words.ex: He uses optical lenses to see small objects.
words.ex_cn: 他使用光学镜片来看小物体。
words.en: Relating to sight, especially in relation to the physical action of light.

words.ex: He is learning optics in physics class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在物理课上学习光学。
words.en: Optics is the branch of physics that involves the study of light and its interactions with matter, including the construction of instruments that use or detect it.

words.ex: The sun's ray came through the window.
words.ex_cn: 阳光透过窗户照进来。
words.en: A ray of light or heat is a narrow beam of it.

words.ex: The colors in the rainbow cover a wide spectrum.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹中的颜色覆盖了广泛的范围。
words.en: A spectrum is a range of a particular type of thing, often a range of colors, ideas, or opinions.

words.ex: The radio wave has a long wavelength.
words.ex_cn: 这个无线电波的波长很长。
words.en: The distance between successive crests of a wave, especially points in a sound wave or electromagnetic wave.

words.ex: He uses a magnifier to read small letters.
words.ex_cn: 他使用放大镜来阅读小字。
words.en: A magnifier is a device that makes small objects look larger, especially a lens or combination of lenses used to produce an enlarged image of an object.

words.ex: The camera has a clear lens.
words.ex_cn: 这台相机有一个清晰的透镜。
words.en: A lens is a piece of curved glass or other transparent substance that is used in things such as cameras, telescopes, or pairs of glasses to make images larger or smaller.

words.ex: The water forms a vortex down the drain.
words.ex_cn: 水在排水口形成一个漩涡。
words.en: A vortex is a mass of wind or water that spins around very fast and pulls objects into its empty center.

words.ex: The computer uses a buffer to store data temporarily.
words.ex_cn: 计算机使用缓冲区临时存储数据。
words.en: A buffer is something that prevents something else from being harmed or that reduces the impact of something.

words.ex: The amoeba reproduces by fission.
words.ex_cn: 阿米巴通过分裂生殖进行繁殖。
words.en: Fission is the splitting of an atomic nucleus, resulting in the release of a large amount of energy.

chapters.name: 按学科分类 Word List 19 政治

words.tr: adj. 派系的；与派系相关的；好争论的
words.ex: The factious group refused to cooperate with others.
words.ex_cn: 这个分裂的团体拒绝与其他人的合作。
words.en: If you describe a group or activity as factious, you mean that it is divided into groups that have strong and unfriendly disagreements.

words.tr:
adj. 偏袒的；党派性的
n. 强烈支持者；党羽；游击队员
words.ex: He gave a partisan answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了偏袒的回答。
words.en: A partisan is a strong supporter of a party, cause, or person. It can also refer to a member of an armed group formed to fight secretly against an occupying force.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.ex: The senate voted to pass the new law.
words.ex_cn: 参议院投票通过了这项新法律。
words.en: The Senate is the smaller and more important of the two parts of the parliament in some countries, for example in the United States and Australia.

words.tr: n. 代表大会；议会；国会；
words.ex: The congress met to discuss new laws.
words.ex_cn: 代表大会召开以讨论新法律。
words.en: A congress is a formal meeting of representatives, as of various nations, to discuss problems or to make decisions.

words.ex: He is a diplomatic ambassador who handles international relations.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位处理国际关系的外交大使。
words.en: Diplomatic means relating to diplomacy or diplomats, or using skill and tact in dealing with people.

words.tr: n. 外交；外交手腕；交际手段
words.ex: He uses diplomacy to solve the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 他用外交手段解决冲突。
words.en: Diplomacy is the activity of managing relations between the governments of different countries, especially in the context of international relations, negotiations, and treaties.

words.ex: The two countries formed a confederate alliance to defend their borders.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家结成了同盟联盟以保卫它们的边界。
words.en: A confederate is someone who works with others to achieve a common goal, often in a political or military context. It can also refer to a member of a confederation, which is a union of states or groups united for a common purpose.

words.ex: The countries formed a peace league.
words.ex_cn: 这些国家组成了一个和平联盟。
words.en: A league is a group of people, countries, or organizations that have joined together for a particular purpose, or because they share a common interest.

words.ex: The local company is an affiliate of the big global brand.
words.ex_cn: 这家本地公司是这个全球大品牌的分公司。
words.en: If an organization is affiliated with another larger organization, it is officially connected with the larger organization or is a member of it.

words.tr: adj. 不合常规的；不符合惯例的；不寻常的；
words.ex: He wears unconventional clothes to stand out.
words.ex_cn: 他穿不合常规的衣服来引人注目。
words.en: If you describe a person or their attitude or behaviour as unconventional, you mean that they do not behave in the same way as most other people in their society.

words.ex: The boss is dictatorial and never listens to others.
words.ex_cn: 老板很专横，从不听别人的意见。
words.en: If you describe someone as dictatorial, you are criticizing them for behaving in a way that shows they expect to be obeyed without question.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.ex: The medicine is potent and works quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物非常有效，起效很快。
words.en: Something that is potent is very effective and powerful.

words.ex: The teacher gave an authoritative answer.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了一个权威性的回答。
words.en: If something is authoritative, it is respected and accepted as true or correct because it comes from a reliable source.

words.ex: He is an influential teacher in our school.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们学校一位有影响力的老师。
words.en: Having great influence on someone or something.

words.tr:
adj. 集中的，中央集权的
v. 集中；形成中心；中央集权；“centralize”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The company has a centralized system for managing all its branches.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有一个集中的系统来管理所有分支机构。
words.en: If something is centralized, it is controlled from one place or by one organization.

words.tr: n. 权威；官方机构；权力；权威人士；当局；
words.ex: The teacher is an authority on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师是古代史方面的权威。
words.en: The power to make decisions or enforce rules.

words.ex: Going first is a privilege, not a right.
words.ex_cn: 优先权是一种特权，而不是权利。
words.en: A privilege is a special right or advantage that only one person or group has.

words.ex: People vote in democracy to choose their leaders.
words.ex_cn: 人们在民主制度下投票选择他们的领导人。
words.en: A system of government by the whole population or all the eligible members of a state, typically through elected representatives.

words.ex: The students handed in a petition to the principal.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向校长递交了一份请愿书。
words.en: A petition is a document signed by a lot of people which asks a government or other official group to do a particular thing.

words.ex: He is an expert in the domain of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 他是人工智能领域的专家。
words.en: A domain is a particular field of thought, activity, or interest, especially one over which someone has control, influence, or rights.

words.ex: The country expanded its territory after the war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在战争后扩大了它的领土。
words.en: An area of land that is controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force.

words.ex: His nationality is Canadian.
words.ex_cn: 他的国籍是加拿大人。
words.en: Nationality is the legal relationship between an individual and a state, often used to refer to the country to which a person belongs.

words.ex: The lion is the king of the animal kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是动物王国之王。
words.en: A kingdom is a country or region that is ruled by a king or queen.

words.ex: This book is about the realm of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于人工智能领域的。
words.en: A realm is a country ruled by a king or queen, or an area of activity, interest, or knowledge.

words.ex: He follows a strict regimen to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循严格的作息计划来保持健康。
words.en: A regimen is a systematic plan or course of action intended to improve or maintain health, or a prescribed routine of diet, exercise, or manner of living.

words.ex: The country values its sovereignty.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家重视它的主权。
words.en: Sovereignty is the power that a country has to govern itself or another country or state.

words.tr: n. 自主权；自治权；自治；
words.ex: The region demands autonomy from the central government.
words.ex_cn: 该地区要求从中央政府获得自主权。
words.en: Autonomy is the ability or condition of being self-governing; independence in one's thoughts or actions.

words.tr:
n. 委员会；佣金；
v. 委托；
words.ex: The commission met to discuss the new law.
words.ex_cn: 委员会开会讨论新法律。
words.en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something, or the act of doing this. It can also refer to a sum of money that is paid to someone for selling something, which is usually a percentage of the value of the goods sold.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.ex: The election will be held next month.
words.ex_cn: 选举将在下个月举行。
words.en: An election is a process in which people vote to choose a person or group of people to hold an official position.

words.tr:
v. 进行无记名投票 
n. 无记名投票
words.ex: He cast his ballot in the election.
words.ex_cn: 他在选举中投了票。
words.en: A ballot is a process of voting, in writing and typically in secret. It is also the piece of paper on which you mark your vote.

words.tr: n. 意识形态；思想体系；
words.ex: His ideology is based on equality and justice.
words.ex_cn: 他的意识形态基于平等与正义。
words.en: An ideology is a set of beliefs, especially one held by a particular group, that influences the way people think and behave.

words.tr:
n. 游行；阅兵；
v. 游行；阅兵；
words.ex: The city held a big parade on Independence Day.
words.ex_cn: 城市在独立日举行了盛大的游行。
words.en: A parade is a procession of people or vehicles moving through a public place in order to celebrate an important day or event.

words.ex: The king governed the land for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 国王统治这个国家50年。
words.en: To govern a country or an organization means to officially control and manage its affairs.

words.ex: The university conferred an honorary degree on him.
words.ex_cn: 大学授予他一个荣誉学位。
words.en: To confer something such as a degree or an honor on someone means to give it to them in a formal way. To confer with someone means to discuss something with them in order to make a decision.

words.tr: v. 授权；命名；给...权利（或资格）
words.ex: This book entitles you to a free gift.
words.ex_cn: 这本书使你有资格获得一份免费礼物。
words.en: If you are entitled to something, you have the right to have it or do it.

words.ex: He exploited the situation to get more money.
words.ex_cn: 他利用这个情况赚了更多钱。
words.en: To exploit someone or something means to use them in a way that benefits you, often unfairly or without considering their rights or feelings. It can also refer to the act of making full use of and deriving benefit from a resource.

words.tr:
n. 精巧动作；军事演习；花招
v. （熟练地）移动；操控；算计
words.ex: The dancer's maneuver was breathtaking.
words.ex_cn: 舞者的精巧动作令人叹为观止。
words.en: A maneuver is a movement or series of movements requiring skill and care.

words.ex: The government announced a major reform in education.
words.ex_cn: 政府宣布了教育方面的重大改革。
words.en: If someone reforms a system, they change or improve it.

words.ex: The teacher will inspect our homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会检查我们的作业。
words.en: If you inspect something, you look at it very carefully, usually in order to find out something about it.

words.ex: He wants to emigrate to Canada for a better life.
words.ex_cn: 他想移民到加拿大过更好的生活。
words.en: To leave one's own country in order to settle permanently in another.

words.ex: They want to immigrate to Canada for a better life.
words.ex_cn: 他们想移民到加拿大过更好的生活。
words.en: To come to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.ex: The king was sent into exile after the revolution.
words.ex_cn: 革命后，国王被流放了。
words.en: Exile is the state of being sent away from one's home country or place of residence, often for political or punitive reasons.

words.tr: v. 奴役；征服；使受控制
words.ex: The cruel king tried to enslave the villagers.
words.ex_cn: 这个残酷的国王试图奴役村民。
words.en: To make someone a slave; to take away someone's freedom.

words.ex: The hustle of the market filled the morning air.
words.ex_cn: 市场的熙攘充满了清晨的空气。
words.en: If you hustle, you work hard to do something quickly, especially in order to earn money.

words.ex: The danger impels him to act quickly.
words.ex_cn: 危险驱使他迅速行动。
words.en: If something impels you to do something, it makes you feel very strongly that you must do it.

words.ex: The team will oust the coach after the loss.
words.ex_cn: 球队在输球后将撤换教练。
words.en: If someone is ousted from a position of power, job, or place, they are forced to leave it.

words.ex: The king banish the traitor from the kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 国王将叛徒驱逐出王国。
words.en: To banish someone means to send them away from a country or place and not allow them to return.

words.tr: v. 驱逐出境；使举止得体
words.ex: They will deport him for breaking the law.
words.ex_cn: 他们将因他违法而驱逐他。
words.en: If a government deports someone, usually someone who is not a citizen of that country, it sends them out of the country because they have committed a crime or because it believes they do not have the right to be there.

words.ex: The new tool enables him to finish work faster.
words.ex_cn: 这个新工具使他能够更快地完成工作。
words.en: If someone or something enables you to do a particular thing, they give you the opportunity or means to do it.

words.ex: The queen's reign lasted 70 years.
words.ex_cn: 女王的统治持续了70年。
words.en: The period during which a sovereign rules; to hold royal office; to prevail

words.ex: He dominates the conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他主宰了谈话。
words.en: To dominate means to control or govern someone or something, or to be the most important or noticeable feature of something.

words.ex: The king decided to abdicate in favor of his son.
words.ex_cn: 国王决定退位，让位给他的儿子。
words.en: If a king or queen abdicates, he or she gives up being king or queen.

words.tr: v. 给予（药物或治疗）；管理；实施；
words.ex: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient.
words.ex_cn: 护士会给病人服药。
words.en: To administer means to manage or oversee the execution, use, or conduct of something; to dispense or apply (a remedy or drug).

words.ex: The administration of the school is very organized.
words.ex_cn: 学校的行政管理非常有条理。
words.en: The process or activity of running a business, organization, etc., or the people who run it.

words.tr:
n. 研究所；学院；协会；
v. 建立；制定；
words.ex: He works at a research institute.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家研究所工作。
words.en: An institute is an organization set up to do a particular type of work, especially research or teaching. It can also refer to the act of starting something such as a system or an official process.

words.ex: The amendment changed the old law.
words.ex_cn: 这项修正案改变了旧法律。
words.en: An amendment is a change or addition to a law or document.

words.ex: Europeans colonized many parts of Africa in the 1800s.
words.ex_cn: 欧洲人在19世纪开拓了非洲的许多地区。
words.en: To colonize means to send people to live in and govern another country.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: The country still has a monarchy with a king as the head of state.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家仍然实行君主制，国王是国家元首。
words.en: A monarchy is a form of government in which a country is ruled by a monarch, such as a king or queen.

words.tr: adj. 共和国的；共和政体的；
words.ex: The republican government passed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 共和国政府通过了一项新法律。
words.en: A republican is a person who supports or belongs to the Republican Party, which is one of the two main political parties in the United States. It can also refer to someone who supports a republic as a form of government.

words.ex: He believes in anarchism and wants no government.
words.ex_cn: 他相信无政府主义，想要没有政府。
words.en: Anarchism is the political belief that there should be little or no formal or official organization to society but that people should work freely together.

words.ex: The church teaches its doctrine to all members.
words.ex_cn: 教会向所有成员传授它的教义。
words.en: A doctrine is a set of beliefs or principles that are taught or accepted by a particular group, especially in religion or politics.

words.ex: The immigrant found a job in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这位移民在城市里找到了一份工作。
words.en: An immigrant is a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.ex: The municipal library is open every day.
words.ex_cn: 这座市政图书馆每天都开放。
words.en: Relating to a city or town or its governing body.

words.tr:
n. 袭击；罢工；
v. 击打；侵袭；突然想到；
words.ex: The strike on the base happened at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 对基地的袭击发生在黎明时分。
words.en: To hit someone or something forcefully; to stop work as a form of protest.

words.ex: The scandal made the news last week.
words.ex_cn: 这起丑闻上周上了新闻。
words.en: A scandal is a situation or event that is thought to be shocking and immoral and that everyone knows about.

words.ex: He will vote for the new leader.
words.ex_cn: 他将投票支持新领袖。
words.en: If you vote, you indicate your choice officially at a meeting or in an election, for example by raising your hand or writing on a piece of paper.

words.ex: The government provides welfare to poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府向贫困家庭提供福利。
words.en: The welfare of a person or group is their health, comfort, and happiness.

words.tr: n. 官僚主义；官僚机构
words.ex: He hates the bureaucracy in government offices.
words.ex_cn: 他讨厌政府办公室里的官僚主义。
words.en: Bureaucracy refers to a system of government or business that has many complicated rules and ways of doing things.

words.ex: The parliament passed a new law about education.
words.ex_cn: 国会通过了一项关于教育的新法律。
words.en: A parliament is a legislative body of government, typically composed of elected representatives, that is responsible for making laws and representing the interests of the people.

words.tr: n. 指明；标示；指定；称号
words.ex: His designation is manager at the company.
words.ex_cn: 他的职位是公司的经理。
words.en: A designation is a name, title, or description given to someone or something, especially one that is official or formal.

chapters.name: 按学科分类 Word List 20 音乐

words.tr: adj. 悦耳的；动听的；和谐的
words.ex: The singer's voice is euphonious.
words.ex_cn: 这位歌手的声音悦耳动听。
words.en: Something that is euphonious has a pleasant sound.

words.ex: The desert has a harsh climate.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的气候非常严酷。
words.en: If you describe something as harsh, you mean that it is extremely difficult and unpleasant to live in, do, or experience, especially because it is very cold, hot, or violent.

words.ex: He plays jazz on the piano every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上用钢琴演奏爵士乐。
words.en: Jazz is a type of music of black American origin characterized by improvisation, syncopation, and usually a regular or forceful rhythm, emerging at the beginning of the 20th century.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.tr:
n. 抒情诗；歌词
adj. 抒情的
words.ex: He wrote a lyric about the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一首关于日落的抒情诗。
words.en: Lyric refers to the words of a song, especially a popular song, or to a short poem that expresses personal feelings and thoughts.

words.ex: The plants grow in the conservatory.
words.ex_cn: 植物在温室里生长。
words.en: A conservatory is a room with glass walls and a glass roof, which is built on the side of a house. It is used as a sun lounge or for growing plants. It can also refer to a school where people are trained in music or acting.

words.tr: n. 事件；一集；一段经历；
words.ex: The accident was a sad episode in his life.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是他生命中的一件悲伤的事。
words.en: An episode is a part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio as one of a series, or a single event or group of related events.

words.ex: He plays violin in a local orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个本地管弦乐队中拉小提琴。
words.en: An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play a variety of different instruments together. Orchestras usually play classical music.

words.tr:
v. 合唱；异口同声地说
n. 合唱团；合唱
words.ex: They chorus when the song reaches the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 当歌曲进行到桥段时，他们一起合唱。
words.en: A chorus is a part of a song which is repeated after each verse, or a group of people who sing together.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.ex: He plays the drum, a type of percussion.
words.ex_cn: 他演奏鼓，一种打击乐器。
words.en: Percussion refers to musical instruments that are played by being struck or shaken, such as drums, cymbals, or tambourines. It can also refer to the act of striking or hitting something.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.tr:
n. 风；
v. 缠绕；蜿蜒；
words.ex: The wind blew strongly through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风猛烈地吹过树木。
words.en: Wind is the natural movement of air, especially in the form of a current of air blowing from a particular direction.

chapters.name: 按学科分类 Word List 21 人物

words.tr:
n. 律师；劝告
v. 提供咨询；劝告
words.ex: He hired a counsel to defend him in court.
words.ex_cn: 他聘请了一名律师为他在法庭上辩护。
words.en: Counsel refers to the act of giving advice or guidance, especially in a legal context, or to the person who provides such advice.

words.tr: n. 全体船员；全体人员；
words.ex: The crew fixed the ship's engine during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 全体船员在风暴中修好了船的引擎。
words.en: A crew is a group of people who work on and operate a ship, aircraft, or train.

words.tr: n. 飞行员；飞机驾驶员
words.ex: The aviator flew a plane over the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员驾机飞越了山脉。
words.en: An aviator is a person who flies an aircraft.

words.ex: He is a famous playwright who writes plays.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的剧作家，写剧本。
words.en: A playwright is a person who writes plays.

words.ex: The operator answered the phone quickly.
words.ex_cn: 接线员迅速接听了电话。
words.en: An operator is a person who operates equipment or a machine, or a person who is in charge of a telephone switchboard.

words.ex: The clergy prayed in the church every morning.
words.ex_cn: 神职人员每天早上在教堂祈祷。
words.en: The clergy are the official leaders of religious activities in certain religions, especially in Christianity.

words.tr: n. 审计员；（大学课程的）旁听生；（一名）听众
words.ex: The auditor checked the company's money records.
words.ex_cn: 审计员检查了公司的财务记录。
words.en: An auditor is a person whose job is to carry out an official examination of the accounts of a business and to produce a report.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: The satirist made fun of the president in his show.
words.ex_cn: 这位讽刺作家在他的节目中嘲笑那位总统。
words.en: A satirist is someone who writes or uses satire.

words.ex: The sculptor carved a statue from stone.
words.ex_cn: 这位雕刻家从石头中雕刻出一座雕像。
words.en: A sculptor is an artist who creates sculptures.

words.ex: He is a famous mathematician.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的数学家。
words.en: A mathematician is a person who is an expert in mathematics, a field that uses numbers, formulas, and logical reasoning to solve problems.

words.ex: The astronaut walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 这名宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: An astronaut is a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft.

words.ex: The astronomer looks at stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 这位天文学家通过望远镜观察星星。
words.en: An astronomer is a scientist who studies celestial bodies such as planets, stars, and galaxies.

words.ex: The spaceman walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: A spaceman is an astronaut, especially a male one, who travels in space.

words.ex: The archaeologist found an old pot in the ground.
words.ex_cn: 这位考古学家在地下发现了一个旧陶罐。
words.en: An archaeologist is someone who studies the societies and cultures of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: The paleoanthropologist digs ancient bones in Africa.
words.ex_cn: 这位古人类学家在非洲挖掘古代骨头。
words.en: A paleoanthropologist is a scientist who studies the origins and predecessors of the present human species, using fossils and other remains.

words.ex: The pilot landed the plane safely.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员安全地降落了飞机。
words.en: A pilot is a person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft. Also, to pilot something means to test or introduce a new idea, product, etc., to see if it will be successful.

words.ex: The meteorologist predicts rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 气象学家预测明天会下雨。
words.en: A meteorologist is a scientist who studies the atmosphere and its phenomena, especially in relation to weather and weather forecasting.

words.ex: The anthropologist studies ancient tribes.
words.ex_cn: 这位人类学家研究古代部落。
words.en: An anthropologist is a person who studies anthropology, which is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: The artist painted a beautiful landscape.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家画了一幅美丽的风景画。
words.en: An artist is someone who draws or paints pictures or creates sculptures as a job or hobby.

words.tr:
n. 意象派诗人
adj. 意象派的
words.ex: He is an imagist who writes clear pictures with words.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位意象派诗人，用文字描绘清晰的画面。
words.en: An imagist is a poet who adheres to the principles of imagism, a movement in early 20th-century poetry that favored precision of imagery and clear, sharp language.

words.tr: n. 发明家；发明者；创造者；
words.ex: Thomas Edison was a famous inventor.
words.ex_cn: 托马斯·爱迪生是一位著名的发明家。
words.en: An inventor is a person who has invented something, or whose job is to invent things.

words.ex: The mechanic fixed my car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 机修工很快修好了我的车。
words.en: A mechanic is a person whose job is to repair and maintain machines and engines, especially those of vehicles.

words.ex: The biographer wrote about the artist's life.
words.ex_cn: 传记作家写了这位艺术家的一生。
words.en: A biographer is a person who writes an account of someone's life.

words.tr:
n. 审查员；检查员
v. 检查；审查
words.ex: The censor removed the bad words from the movie.
words.ex_cn: 审查员从电影中删除了粗俗用语。
words.en: A censor is a person who supervises conduct and morals: in particular, one who examines books, films, or other material for objectionable matter.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.tr: n. 隐士；隐居者；遁世者
words.ex: The hermit lives alone in a small cave.
words.ex_cn: 这位隐士独自住在一个小山洞里。
words.en: A hermit is someone who lives alone and apart from society, often for religious reasons.

words.tr: n. 隐居者；遁世者；隐士
words.ex: He lives as a recluse in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 他住在树林里，过着隐居的生活。
words.en: A recluse is a person who lives alone and avoids other people.

words.tr: n. 生态学家；生态学者；
words.ex: The ecologist studied birds in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位生态学家研究了森林里的鸟类。
words.en: An ecologist is a scientist who studies the relationships between living things and their environment.

words.ex: The critic praised the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位评论家称赞了这部新电影。
words.en: A critic is a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of books, films, music, etc.

words.ex: He is a philanthropist who gives money to poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位向贫困儿童捐款的慈善家。
words.en: A philanthropist is someone who helps others, especially by giving money to people who need it.

words.tr: n. 律师；辩护律师；代理人
words.ex: The attorney helped the man with his case.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助那个人处理了他的案件。
words.en: An attorney is a lawyer who is qualified to represent a client in court.

words.ex: The congressman spoke to the people in his town.
words.ex_cn: 这位国会议员向他所在城镇的人们发表了讲话。
words.en: A congressman is a member of the United States Congress, especially of the House of Representatives.

words.ex: He is a connoisseur of fine wine.
words.ex_cn: 他是优质葡萄酒的行家。
words.en: A connoisseur is a person who is especially competent to pass critical judgments in an art, particularly one of the fine arts, or in matters of taste.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；承包人；
words.ex: He is an entrepreneur who started a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创办了小型咖啡店的企业家。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；最重要的；
n. 校长；负责人；
words.ex: The principal reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The person with the highest authority or most important position in an organization, institution, or group.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.ex: The commander gave the order to advance.
words.ex_cn: 指挥官下达了前进的命令。
words.en: A commander is a person in authority, especially in the armed forces, who gives orders and is responsible for the actions of those under their command.

words.ex: The commentator explained the game clearly.
words.ex_cn: 评论员清晰地解释了比赛。
words.en: A commentator is someone who gives a commentary on something such as a sports event or a television program.

words.tr:
n. 服务人员
adj. 随之而来的
words.ex: The attendant helped me find my seat.
words.ex_cn: 服务员帮我找到了座位。
words.en: An attendant is someone whose job is to serve or help people in a public place.

words.ex: The trapper caught a fox in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 捕兽者在树林里抓到了一只狐狸。
words.en: A trapper is a person who traps wild animals, especially for their fur.

words.tr: n. 演说者；演讲者；雄辩家；
words.ex: He is a famous orator who speaks at large events.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位在大型活动中演讲的著名演说者。
words.en: An orator is a person who delivers speeches or lectures, especially one who is skilled at doing so.

words.ex: He called his friend an idiot after the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他在犯错后称朋友是白痴。
words.en: An idiot is a person who is considered to be very stupid or foolish.

words.ex: His decision to drive drunk was pure idiocy.
words.ex_cn: 他酒后驾车的决定简直是白痴行为。
words.en: If you refer to a particular action or situation as idiocy, you mean that it is very stupid or foolish.

words.ex: He called the man a moron for forgetting his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他因为那个人忘了带钥匙而叫他傻瓜。
words.en: A very stupid person.

words.tr:
adj. 文盲的；无知的；
n. 文盲；无知识的人；
words.ex: He is illiterate and cannot read simple signs.
words.ex_cn: 他是文盲，无法阅读简单的标识。
words.en: Someone who is illiterate cannot read or write.

words.tr: n. 代理人；代表；代理权；代理服务器
words.ex: He gave his friend a proxy to vote for him.
words.ex_cn: 他让朋友当他的代理人替他投票。
words.en: A proxy is a person or thing that is authorized to act on behalf of another, especially in voting or representing someone in a meeting.

words.ex: The deputy signed the document for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 代理人替经理签署了文件。
words.en: A deputy is a person who is appointed to act as a substitute for another, especially in a position of authority.

words.tr: n. 所有者；经营者 ；业主
words.ex: The proprietor runs a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 店主经营一家小咖啡馆。
words.en: A proprietor is a person who owns a particular type of business, especially a hotel, a shop, or a company.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.ex: The employer gave her a raise.
words.ex_cn: 雇主给她加了薪。
words.en: An employer is a person or organization that employs people, paying them for their work.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.ex: The debtor paid back the money last week.
words.ex_cn: 债务人上周还了钱。
words.en: A debtor is a person, organization, or country that owes money.

words.ex: The arbitrator helped the two sides reach an agreement.
words.ex_cn: 仲裁员帮助双方达成了协议。
words.en: An arbitrator is a person who has been officially chosen to make a decision between two people or groups who do not agree.

words.ex: The superintendent of the school is very strict.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主管非常严格。
words.en: A superintendent is a person who is in charge of a particular department or activity, especially within a school, housing project, or police force.

words.ex: He is an apprentice in a car repair shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是汽车修理店的一名学徒。
words.en: An apprentice is a young person who works for someone in order to learn their skill.

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

words.ex: The miser saved all his money and never spent it.
words.ex_cn: 这个吝啬鬼把所有的钱都存起来，从不花掉。
words.en: A miser is a person who is extremely unwilling to spend money, often to the point of living in poverty despite having wealth.

words.ex: The donor gave money to the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 捐赠者向医院捐了钱。
words.en: A donor is a person or organization that gives something, especially money, to a charity or other organization.

words.tr: n. 全体人员；人事部；职员；
words.ex: The company hired new personnel last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月雇佣了新员工。
words.en: The people who are employed in a company or organization.

words.tr: n. 恩人；捐助者；赠送者
words.ex: The benefactor gave money to the school.
words.ex_cn: 资助人捐钱给学校。
words.en: A benefactor is a person who gives money or other help to a person or cause.

words.tr:
n. 凡人
adj. 致命的；终有一死的
words.ex: All mortal beings must die someday.
words.ex_cn: 所有凡人都终有一死。
words.en: If you refer to the fact that people are mortal, you mean that they have to die and cannot live forever.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
words.en: The group of spectators at a public event; listeners or viewers collectively, especially those attending a performance or reading a particular work.

words.ex: He is the recipient of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个奖项的接受者。
words.en: A recipient is a person who receives something.

words.tr:
adj. 居住的；常驻的；
n. 常住居民；
words.ex: The resident population grew last year.
words.ex_cn: 居住人口去年增加了。
words.en: A resident is someone who lives in a particular place or a person who has their home in a place.

words.ex: The inhabitant lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位居民住在一所小房子里。
words.en: An inhabitant of a place is one of the people who live there.

words.ex: He earned a bachelor in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了计算机科学学士学位。
words.en: A bachelor is a man who has never been married.

words.ex: He looks up to his favorite singer as an idol.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己最喜欢的歌手当作偶像。
words.en: An idol is a person or thing that is greatly admired, loved, or revered.

words.ex: He is a novice at playing the guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他是个吉他新手。
words.en: A novice is someone who has just started learning or doing something and does not have much experience.

words.tr: n. 信仰者；信徒；相信…者
words.ex: He is a true believer in hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他坚信努力工作的重要性。
words.en: A believer is someone who is sure that something is true or exists, especially a religious or political belief.

words.ex: Some people follow that cult blindly.
words.ex_cn: 有些人盲目追随那个狂热崇拜。
words.en: A cult is a group of people who have extreme admiration for a particular person, idea, or thing, often following unusual or extreme practices or beliefs.

words.tr:
adj. 狂热入迷的；盲信的
n. 狂热者；盲信者
words.ex: He is a fanatic fan of soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他对足球狂热入迷。
words.en: A fanatic is a person who is very enthusiastic about and devoted to a particular activity, cause, or belief, often to an extreme degree.

words.tr:
n. 拥护者；信徒
adj. 黏附…的
words.ex: He is an adherent of the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 他是这项新政策的拥护者。
words.en: An adherent is someone who supports a particular party, person, or set of ideas.

words.tr: adj. 忠实的；虔诚的；可靠的；
words.ex: He is a faithful friend who always helps me.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个总是帮助我的忠实朋友。
words.en: Someone who is faithful remains loyal to a person, belief, or cause, and continues to support them.

words.ex: He was a faithful disciple of the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是老师的一名忠实弟子。
words.en: A disciple is a follower or student of a teacher, leader, or philosopher.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.ex: The king was killed by an assassin.
words.ex_cn: 国王被一名刺客杀害了。
words.en: An assassin is a person who murders an important person for political or religious reasons.

words.ex: The bandit stole money from the bank.
words.ex_cn: 强盗从银行偷了钱。
words.en: A bandit is a person who robs people, especially one of a group of people who attack travelers.

words.ex: The burglar broke into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 窃贼在夜里闯入了房子。
words.en: A burglar is a person who illegally enters buildings and steals things.

words.tr:
n. 野蛮人
adj. 野蛮的
words.ex: The barbarian attacked the village with a sword.
words.ex_cn: 野蛮人用剑袭击了村庄。
words.en: A barbarian is a person who is considered to be uncivilized or uncultured.

words.ex: The king was sent into exile after the revolution.
words.ex_cn: 革命后，国王被流放了。
words.en: Exile is the state of being sent away from one's home country or place of residence, often for political or punitive reasons.

words.ex: The rebel fought against the king's rules.
words.ex_cn: 这位叛逆者反抗国王的法令。
words.en: A rebel is a person who opposes or fights against people in authority.

words.ex: He is an addict who cannot stop smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他是个无法戒烟的瘾君子。
words.en: An addict is someone who is unable to stop taking harmful drugs, or someone who is very interested in something and spends a lot of time doing it.

words.tr: n. 自我主义者；利己主义者
words.ex: He is an egoist who only thinks about himself.
words.ex_cn: 他是个只为自己着想的利己主义者。
words.en: An egoist is someone who is excessively self-centered and selfish, often disregarding the needs and feelings of others.

words.ex: The eyewitness saw the accident happen.
words.ex_cn: 目击者看到了事故的发生。
words.en: An eyewitness is a person who has seen something happen and can give a first-hand description of it.

words.ex: The spectator watched the game quietly.
words.ex_cn: 旁观者安静地观看了比赛。
words.en: A spectator is someone who watches an event, show, game, or activity.

words.ex: He bought a gift for his spouse.
words.ex_cn: 他给他的配偶买了一份礼物。
words.en: A spouse is a person's partner in marriage.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.ex: He is the beneficiary of his father's will.
words.ex_cn: 他是他父亲遗嘱的受益人。
words.en: A beneficiary is someone who receives money or other benefits as a result of something, especially a will or insurance policy.

words.ex: This product is inferior to the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这个产品比另一个差。
words.en: If one person or thing is inferior to another, they are not as good, important, or valuable as the other person or thing.

words.ex: He is a zealot for environmental protection.
words.ex_cn: 他是环境保护的热心者。
words.en: A zealot is someone who is extremely enthusiastic about something, especially religion or politics.

words.ex: The bicycle was a precursor to the car.
words.ex_cn: 自行车是汽车的先驱。
words.en: A precursor is something that happened or existed before another thing, especially if it either developed into it or had an influence on it.

words.tr:
adj. 先锋的；前卫的
n. 先锋派；前卫
words.ex: The artist uses avant-garde styles in her paintings.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家在她的画作中使用前卫的风格。
words.en: Avant-garde is used to describe people or works that are experimental or innovative, particularly in the arts.

words.ex: The school invited its alumni to the annual reunion.
words.ex_cn: 学校邀请了它的校友参加年度聚会。
words.en: Alumni are former students of a particular school, college, or university.

words.tr: n. 怀疑论者；怀疑宗教主张的人；无神论者
words.ex: He is a skeptic about new health claims.
words.ex_cn: 他对新的健康说法持怀疑态度。
words.en: A skeptic is a person who questions the validity or authenticity of something purporting to be factual.

words.tr:
adj. 不满的；不服的
n. 不满现状的人；反抗者
words.ex: The malcontent workers complained about low pay.
words.ex_cn: 不满的员工抱怨工资太低。
words.en: A malcontent is a person who is dissatisfied and rebellious.

words.ex: He saw his neighbor as a foe.
words.ex_cn: 他把邻居看作敌人。
words.en: A foe is someone who opposes or fights against another; an enemy.

words.ex: He defeated his opponent in the chess game.
words.ex_cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: An opponent is someone who is competing against you in a contest, game, or argument, or someone who is opposed to an idea or plan.

words.tr:
n. 竞争者；敌手；
v. 竞争；相匹敌；
words.ex: He is my main rival in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他是我在比赛中主要的竞争者。
words.en: A rival is a person, group, or organization that you are competing with in the same activity or the same area.

words.ex: The celebrity smiled at the fans outside the theater.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人向剧院外的粉丝微笑。
words.en: A celebrity is a famous person, especially in entertainment or sports.

words.tr: n. 装饰船头的人像；傀儡领袖；有名无实的首脑；
words.ex: The old ship had a wooden figurehead of a lion.
words.ex_cn: 那艘旧船的船头有一个木制的狮子像。
words.en: A figurehead is a person who is the head of an organization or country in name only, without any real power or authority.

words.ex: He is a veteran player with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位经验丰富的老练球员。
words.en: A veteran is someone who has a lot of experience in a particular field or activity, especially in the armed forces.

words.tr: n. 叛徒；背叛者；卖国贼
words.ex: He was called a traitor for helping the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 他因为帮助敌人而被称为叛徒。
words.en: A traitor is a person who betrays a friend, country, principle, etc.

words.tr:
n. 提倡者；
v. 提倡；
words.ex: He is an advocate for clean water.
words.ex_cn: 他是清洁用水的提倡者。
words.en: If you advocate a particular action or plan, you recommend it publicly.

words.tr:
n. 女权主义者
adj. 女权主义的
words.ex: She is a feminist who believes in equal rights.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位相信平等权利的女权主义者。
words.en: A feminist is a person who believes in and supports the rights and equality of women.

words.tr: adj. 人道主义的；慈善的；
words.ex: The humanitarian aid helped the hungry children.
words.ex_cn: 人道主义援助帮助了饥饿的孩子们。
words.en: A humanitarian is someone who is involved in or connected with improving people's lives and reducing suffering.

words.tr:
n. 人群；一大群；众多
v. 群集；挤满；涌进
words.ex: A throng of people waited outside the store.
words.ex_cn: 一大群人站在商店外面等候。
words.en: A large, densely packed crowd of people or animals.

words.ex: The civilian population stayed safe during the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 平民在冲突期间保持安全。
words.en: A civilian is a person who is not a member of the military or of a police or firefighting force.

words.ex: The monarch ruled the country for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 这位君主统治这个国家长达50年。
words.en: A monarch is a king, queen, emperor, or empress.

words.ex: He is a conservative man who likes old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢古老传统的保守男子。
words.en: A conservative person or group is one that does not like changes or new ideas, especially in politics or religion.

words.tr: n. 使节；特使；外交使节；
words.ex: The envoy met the president to discuss peace.
words.ex_cn: 使节会见了总统以讨论和平事宜。
words.en: An envoy is a representative sent by one government or leader to another, especially in order to carry out a particular task or to negotiate.

words.ex: The aristocrat lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 这位贵族住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: An aristocrat is a person of high rank in a society, especially one who inherits a title and lands.

words.ex: The gentry owned most of the land in the old village.
words.ex_cn: 绅士阶层拥有这个古老村庄的大部分土地。
words.en: The gentry are people of high social class, especially in the past.

words.ex: The autocrat rules the country with no elections.
words.ex_cn: 独裁者在没有选举的情况下统治国家。
words.en: An autocrat is a ruler who has absolute power.

words.ex: The manager will delegate the task to her assistant.
words.ex_cn: 经理将把这个任务委派给她的助手。
words.en: A delegate is a person who is chosen or elected to vote or make decisions on behalf of a group of people, especially at a conference or a meeting. As a verb, to delegate means to give a task or responsibility to another person, especially someone who is less senior than you.

words.tr: n. 民主主义者；民主党员；
words.ex: He is a democrat who believes in equal rights for all.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位相信所有人平等权利的民主主义者。
words.en: A democrat is someone who believes in the principles of democracy, such as the idea that everyone should have an equal say in how their country is governed.

words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.ex: He is a candidate for the mayor position.
words.ex_cn: 他是市长职位的候选人。
words.en: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

words.ex: The priest said a prayer for the sick.
words.ex_cn: 牧师为病人祈祷。
words.en: A priest is a person who is qualified to perform religious duties and ceremonies in a Christian church.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

chapters.name: 按学科分类 Word List 22 气象

words.tr: adj. 温和宜人的（气候）；芳香的
words.ex: The balmy wind felt nice on her skin.
words.ex_cn: 温暖的微风轻拂她的皮肤。
words.en: Balmy weather is pleasantly warm and mild.

words.ex: The air feels humid after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气感觉湿润。
words.en: You use humid to describe an atmosphere or climate that is very damp, and usually very hot.

words.ex: The humidity in the room made the air feel heavy.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的湿度让空气感觉很闷。
words.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air. High humidity makes the air feel wet and sticky.

words.ex: The ground is damp after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是潮湿的。
words.en: Something that is damp is slightly wet, often in a way that is unpleasant.

words.ex: The basement was dank and cold.
words.ex_cn: 地下室又潮又冷。
words.en: Unpleasantly damp and cold.

words.ex: The soil has too much moisture.
words.ex_cn: 土壤中有太多湿气。
words.en: Moisture is tiny drops of water in the air, on a surface, or in a substance, that make it feel wet.

words.tr: v. 使浸透；使湿透；使满；使饱和
words.ex: The sponge will saturate if you pour too much water.
words.ex_cn: 如果你倒太多水，海绵会吸满。
words.en: To saturate something means to make it completely wet, or to fill it completely with something so that no more can be added.

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.ex: The arid land has little rain and no trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片干旱的土地降雨稀少，没有树木。
words.en: An arid area of land has so little rain that it is very dry and cannot support much vegetation.

words.tr: adj. 寒冷的；冷淡的；冷漠的；
words.ex: The morning air was chilly.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的空气很寒冷。
words.en: Something that is chilly is unpleasantly cold.

words.tr:
n. 寒冷；寒意；
v. 变冷；使冰冷；
words.ex: The chill of the morning made me wear a jacket.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的寒冷让我穿上了夹克。
words.en: A chill is a feeling of coldness, often accompanied by shivering. It can also refer to a feeling of fear or anxiety. As a verb, to chill means to make something cold, or to relax and take it easy.

words.tr: adj. 寒冷的；冷淡的；性冷淡的（女子）
words.ex: The water is frigid in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天的水很冰冷。
words.en: Frigid means extremely cold in temperature or lacking warmth or enthusiasm.

words.tr: adj. 平静的；宁静的；安详的
words.ex: The lake is serene in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的湖面很宁静。
words.en: Calm, peaceful, and untroubled; tranquil.

words.tr: adj. 微温的；不冷不热的；不热情的
words.ex: He drank the tepid water slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地喝着温吞的水。
words.en: Slightly warm; lukewarm. Also, showing little enthusiasm.

words.ex: The gale knocked down several trees.
words.ex_cn: 大风刮倒了几棵树。
words.en: A gale is a very strong wind.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: The barometer shows that the weather will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 晴雨表显示天气会很好。
words.en: A barometer is an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure, used especially in forecasting the weather and determining altitude.

words.ex: A gentle breeze blew through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一阵微风轻轻吹过树梢。
words.en: A breeze is a gentle wind.

words.tr: n. 一阵强劲的气流；爆炸；
words.ex: A blast of cold wind hit the window.
words.ex_cn: 一阵冷风击中了窗户。
words.en: A blast is a sudden loud noise or a strong gust of wind. It can also refer to an explosion or the act of blowing something up. As a verb, it means to explode or to criticize severely.

words.ex: The kids created a whirlwind in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在客厅里弄出了一片忙乱。
words.en: A whirlwind is a tall, spinning column of air that moves across the land or water surface, often causing destruction. It can also refer to a very intense or fast-paced situation or activity.

words.ex: The typhoon destroyed many houses last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周的台风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A typhoon is a very violent tropical storm that occurs in the western Pacific Ocean.

words.ex: The tornado destroyed the small house.
words.ex_cn: 龙卷风摧毁了那座小房子。
words.en: A tornado is a violent windstorm characterized by a twisting, funnel-shaped cloud.

words.ex: He works in meteorology and predicts the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他从事气象学工作，预测天气。
words.en: Meteorology is the scientific study of the atmosphere and of atmospheric conditions, especially as they relate to weather and weather forecasting.

words.ex: The troposphere is the lowest layer of the atmosphere.
words.ex_cn: 对流层是大气的最低层。
words.en: The troposphere is the lowest layer of the Earth's atmosphere, extending from the Earth's surface up to about 8 to 15 kilometers high. It is where most weather phenomena occur.

words.tr:
n. 漏斗；
v. 输送；
words.ex: He poured the oil through a funnel.
words.ex_cn: 他把油通过漏斗倒了进去。
words.en: A funnel is an object with a wide, circular top and a narrow tube at the bottom, used for pouring liquids or powders into containers with small openings.

words.ex: The city has heavy smog in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市冬天有严重的雾霾。
words.en: Smog is a mixture of smoke and fog, or a similar mixture of air pollutants, which can be harmful to health.

words.ex: The car drove slowly through the fog.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓缓驶过浓雾。
words.en: Fog is a thick cloud of tiny water droplets suspended in the atmosphere at or near the earth's surface which obscures or restricts visibility (to a greater extent than mist; strictly, reducing visibility to below 1 km).

words.tr:
v. 加速（坏事的发生）
n. 沉淀物；冷凝物
adj. 轻率的；仓促的
words.ex: The scandal precipitated the politician's resignation.
words.ex_cn: 这起丑闻加速了这位政治家的辞职。
words.en: To cause something to happen suddenly or unexpectedly; to cause a substance to be deposited in solid form from a solution.

words.ex: The precipitation increased last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周降水增加了。
words.en: Precipitation is rain, snow, sleet, or hail — any kind of weather condition where something's falling from the sky.

words.tr:
v. 下毛毛雨；（毛毛雨似的）洒落
n. 毛毛细雨
words.ex: It is drizzling outside.
words.ex_cn: 外面正在下毛毛雨。
words.en: Light rain falling in very fine drops.

words.ex: A blizzard covered the town in snow.
words.ex_cn: 一场暴风雪将整个小镇覆盖在雪中。
words.en: A blizzard is a severe snowstorm with strong winds.

words.ex: Dew forms on the grass in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨露水出现在草地上。
words.en: Dew is small drops of water that form on the ground and other surfaces outside during the night.

words.ex: The downpour soaked everyone outside.
words.ex_cn: 暴雨把外面的每个人都淋湿了。
words.en: A downpour is a sudden and unexpected heavy fall of rain.

words.ex: A droplet fell from the leaf.
words.ex_cn: 一滴水从叶子上落下。
words.en: A droplet is a very small drop of a liquid.

words.ex: There was frost on the grass this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上草地上有霜。
words.en: A thin layer of ice that forms on surfaces when the temperature drops below freezing.

words.ex: The water vapor rose into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 水蒸气升上了天空。
words.en: Vapor is a substance in the gas phase at a temperature lower than its critical temperature, which means that the vapor can be condensed to a liquid by increasing its pressure without reducing the temperature.

words.ex: The fishermen feared the tempest at sea.
words.ex_cn: 渔民们害怕海上的暴风雨。
words.en: A tempest is a violent and windy storm.

words.ex: I take a shower every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都洗淋浴。
words.en: A shower is a device that sprays water over you so that you can wash yourself. It is also a short period of rain or snow.

words.tr:
n. 冰雹；
v. 把…誉为；
words.ex: The hail broke many car windows.
words.ex_cn: 冰雹打碎了许多汽车窗户。
words.en: Hail is small balls of ice that fall like rain from the sky. It can also mean to call out to someone in order to attract their attention, or to praise someone enthusiastically.

words.ex: The steam condenses into water when it touches the cold glass.
words.ex_cn: 当蒸汽接触到冷的玻璃时，会凝结成水。
words.en: If you condense something, especially a piece of writing or a speech, you make it shorter, usually by including only the most important parts.

words.ex: She wears a necklace made of crystal.
words.ex_cn: 她戴一条水晶制成的项链。
words.en: A crystal is a solid that has a regular, repeating arrangement of atoms. Crystals are often transparent and can be used in jewelry or as decorative objects.

chapters.name: 按学科分类 Word List 23 法律

words.ex: The penal system aims to punish criminals.
words.ex_cn: 刑罚制度旨在惩罚罪犯。
words.en: Relating to, used for, or prescribing the punishment of offenders under the legal system.

words.ex: The police seized illicit drugs from the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察从嫌疑人那里没收了非法毒品。
words.en: Illicit activities or substances are not allowed by law or by social or religious custom.

words.tr: adj. 不守规矩的；难控制的；难管束的
words.ex: The unruly child refused to sit quietly.
words.ex_cn: 这个不守规矩的孩子不肯安静地坐着。
