words.ex: The contrast between light and dark is clear in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中明暗的对照很明显。
words.en: A contrast is a great difference between two or more things which is clear when you compare them.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.tr:
n. 副本；(书，报纸等的) 一本；复制品；
v. 复制；
words.ex: Please give me a copy of the report.
words.ex_cn: 请给我一份报告的副本。
words.en: A copy is a thing made to be similar or identical to another. As a verb, to copy means to make a similar or identical version of something.

words.ex: The child imitates her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If you imitate someone, you copy what they do or produce.

words.ex: The boy resembles his father.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩长得像他父亲。
words.en: If one thing or person resembles another, they are similar to each other.

words.tr: n. 喜爱；类同；密切关系；亲和力
words.ex: She has an affinity for painting.
words.ex_cn: 她喜爱绘画。
words.en: A natural liking for or attraction to someone or something.

words.ex: The two colors distinguish the two teams.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色使两个队伍有所不同。
words.en: If you can distinguish one thing from another, you can see or understand how they are different.

words.ex: I like coffee, and she likes it likewise.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，她也喜欢。
words.en: You use likewise when you are comparing two methods, states, or situations and saying that they are similar.

words.tr: adj. 异种的；异质的；由不同成份形成的
words.ex: The class is heterogeneous, with students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级是多元的，有来自许多国家的学生。
words.en: A heterogeneous group consists of many different types of things or people.

words.ex: He is merely a student.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅是个学生。
words.en: You use merely to emphasize that something is only what you say and not better, more important, or more exciting.

chapters.name: 按意群分类 Word List 35 事物 范围

words.ex: Everyone passed the test, with one exception.
words.ex_cn: 所有人都通过了考试，只有一个例外。
words.en: An exception is a person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；杰出的；罕见的；特别的；
words.ex: She is an exceptional student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 她是一名卓越的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: An exceptional person or thing has some unusual quality or ability that makes them different from others.

words.tr: adj. 感到宽慰的； v. 缓解；“relieve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt relieved when he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 当他通过考试时，他感到宽慰。
words.en: If you are relieved, you feel happy because something unpleasant has not happened or is no longer happening.

words.tr:
adj. 额外的；
n. 额外的事物；
adv. 额外地；
words.ex: He did extra work to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他做了额外的工作来赚更多的钱。
words.en: If something is extra, it is added to an existing amount or number.

words.ex: The extraneous noise made it hard to concentrate.
words.ex_cn: 那些无关的噪音让人难以集中注意力。
words.en: Something that is extraneous is not relevant or essential to the subject you are dealing with.

words.tr: adj. 无关紧要的；不相关的；
words.ex: His opinion is irrelevant to the decision.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见与这个决定无关紧要。
words.en: If you describe something as irrelevant, you mean that it is not important to or not connected with the present situation or discussion.

words.ex: The rule excludes children under 12.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则排除了12岁以下的孩子。
words.en: To exclude someone or something means to prevent them from entering a place or taking part in an activity.

words.ex: This brand has an exclusive design.
words.ex_cn: 这个品牌拥有独有的设计。
words.en: Something that is exclusive is available only to particular people, and not to everyone.

words.tr: n. 排除；排斥；被排除在外的事物；
words.ex: The exclusion of students from the test was unfair.
words.ex_cn: 将学生排除在考试之外是不公平的。
words.en: The act of preventing someone or something from entering a place or taking part in an activity.

words.tr: adj. 不合常规的；不符合惯例的；不寻常的；
words.ex: He wears unconventional clothes to stand out.
words.ex_cn: 他穿不合常规的衣服来引人注目。
words.en: If you describe a person or their attitude or behaviour as unconventional, you mean that they do not behave in the same way as most other people in their society.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

words.tr: adj. 鲁莽的；无礼的；不相干的
words.ex: He gave an impertinent answer to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他给了老师一个鲁莽的回答。
words.en: If someone talks or behaves in a rather impolite and disrespectful way, especially towards someone who is older or in a position of authority, you can describe that person or their behaviour as impertinent.

words.tr:
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 此外；
words.ex: Besides apples, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还喜欢橙子。
words.en: In addition to; apart from.

words.ex: The scope of this project includes three cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的范围包括三个城市。
words.en: The range of one's perceptions, thoughts, or actions.

words.tr:
n. 时距；跨度；
v. 跨越；
words.ex: The span of his career was 40 years.
words.ex_cn: 他职业生涯的时距是40年。
words.en: The extent or measure of space between two points or extremities, as of a bridge or a roof; the full extent, stretch, or reach of anything.

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.tr:
v. 节省；拯救；保存；
prep. 除...之外；除了；
words.ex: He saves money by walking to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过步行上班来节省钱。
words.en: To save something means to keep it from being lost or damaged; to save money or time is to avoid spending more than necessary.

words.ex: The car deviated from the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车偏离了道路。
words.en: To deviate means to do something that is different from the usual or common way of behaving.

words.ex: He digresses when he talks about his vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他谈论假期时会跑题。
words.en: If you digress, you move away from the subject you are talking or writing about and talk or write about something different for a while.

words.ex: He finally embraced the new idea.
words.ex_cn: 他最终接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To take someone into your arms as a sign of love or affection, or to accept something enthusiastically.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.ex: The team comprises five players and one coach.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队包括五名球员和一名教练。
words.en: If you say that something comprises or is comprised of a number of things or people, you mean it has them as its parts or members.

words.ex: The teacher showed a bias for students who arrived early.
words.ex_cn: 老师对早到的学生有偏爱。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.ex: The mirror deflects the light to the wall.
words.ex_cn: 镜子把光线反射到墙上。
words.en: If you deflect something such as criticism or attention, you act in a way that prevents it from being directed towards you or affecting you.

words.tr: v. 体现；使具体化；包含
words.ex: He embodies kindness and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他体现了善良和耐心。
words.en: To embody means to represent a quality or an idea exactly; to include or contain something.

words.tr: v. 容纳；适应；为...提供住宿；
words.ex: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店能容纳200位客人。
words.en: If a building or space can accommodate someone or something, it has enough room for them.

words.ex: The rain precludes a picnic.
words.ex_cn: 下雨阻止了野餐。
words.en: If something precludes an event or action, it prevents it from happening.

chapters.name: 按意群分类 Word List 35 事物 方法

words.tr: adj. 直截了当的；直率的；坦白的
words.ex: He is forthright about his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他坦率地承认自己的错误。
words.en: If you describe someone as forthright, you admire them because they show clearly and strongly what they think and feel.

words.ex: He found a shortcut to school.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一条去学校的捷径。
words.en: A quicker or more direct way to get somewhere or do something.

words.ex: The tip of the pencil broke off.
words.ex_cn: 铅笔的尖端断了。
words.en: The end of a pointed or projecting object; a sum of money given to someone as a reward for their services; to give someone a small amount of money as a reward for their services.

words.tr:
v. 意思是说；表示…的意思；
n. 手段；方法；收入；
words.ex: This sign means you cannot park here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志意思是说这里不能停车。
words.en: Means refers to a method or way of doing something, or the resources or assets available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He sent the message via email.
words.ex_cn: 他通过电子邮件发送了这条消息。
words.en: If you go somewhere via a particular place, you go through that place on the way to your destination.

words.tr:
adj. 直接的；
v. 指导；指示；
words.ex: He gave a direct answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了直接的答案。
words.en: If you direct something at a particular thing, you aim or point it at that thing.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

chapters.name: 按意群分类 Word List 35 事物 光

words.ex: The faint light from the candle barely lit the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛微弱的光几乎照不亮房间。
words.en: If you feel faint, you feel weak and as if you are about to lose consciousness. Something that is faint is not strong or clear.

words.tr:
n. 黑暗；忧郁；幽暗
v. 变阴暗；变忧郁
words.ex: The room was filled with gloom after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后，房间里一片黑暗。
words.en: Gloom is a feeling of sadness and lack of hope.

words.tr: adj. 黑暗的；幽暗的；忧郁的；沮丧的
words.ex: The room was gloomy with no windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间没有窗户，很黑暗。
words.en: If a place is gloomy, it is almost dark so that you cannot see very well. If people are gloomy, they are unhappy and have no hope.

words.ex: The luminous moon lights up the night.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的月亮照亮了夜晚。
words.en: Something that is luminous shines or glows in the dark.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.tr: adj. 又黑又脏的；昏暗的；肮脏的
words.ex: The room was dingy and small.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间又脏又小。
words.en: If you describe a place or thing as dingy, you mean that it is rather dull and depressing to look at, and perhaps also dirty.

words.tr:
adj. 暗淡的；昏暗的；模糊的
v. （使）变暗淡；（使）变模糊；（使）减弱
words.ex: The room is dim because the lights are off.
words.ex_cn: 房间很暗，因为灯关了。
words.en: If a light or a place is dim, it is not bright or is not lit very strongly.

words.ex: The meaning of the poem is obscure.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的意思不清楚。
words.en: If something is obscure, it is not well known or not easily understood.

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.tr: adj. 昏暗的；暗淡的；暗黑的
words.ex: The sky became dusky at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空变得昏暗。
words.en: Dusky is used to describe something that is dark in color or not bright, especially in a way that is attractive or mysterious.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.tr: adj. 明显的； v. “glare”的现在分词；
words.ex: The mistake was glaring to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误对每个人来说都很明显。
words.en: If you describe something bad as glaring, you are emphasizing that it is very obvious and easily seen.

words.tr: adj. 眼花缭乱的；耀眼的； v. “dazzle”的现在分词；
words.ex: The dazzling lights of the city made her blink.
words.ex_cn: 城市的耀眼灯光让她眨了眨眼。
words.en: If you describe something as dazzling, you mean that it is extremely impressive, beautiful, or skilful.

words.ex: The sky was dismal and gray all day.
words.ex_cn: 天空一整天都是阴沉灰暗的。
words.en: If you describe something as dismal, you mean that it is very bad or depressing.

words.ex: The magazine has a glossy cover.
words.ex_cn: 这本杂志有一个光滑的封面。
words.en: Something that is glossy is smooth and shiny.

words.tr:
n. 群；团；簇；
v. 聚集；
words.ex: The stars form a bright cluster in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中形成了一群明亮的星群。
words.en: A cluster of things or people is a small group of them close together.

words.tr:
v. 上釉；上玻璃；浇浆汁于；变呆滞
n. 釉料；光滑面；覆罩的一层
words.ex: The potter glazes the clay bowl before firing it.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠在烧制前给陶碗上釉。
words.en: To glaze means to fit panes of glass into a window frame or similar structure. It can also refer to the process of applying a glossy, often transparent, coating to pottery or other materials.

words.tr:
v. （突然）烧旺；闪耀；突然爆发；张开；加剧
n. 旺火；亮光
words.ex: The fire began to flare up suddenly.
words.ex_cn: 火突然燃了起来。
words.en: A flare is a sudden bright light or flame, or a sudden increase in something such as activity or trouble.

words.tr:
v. 擦亮；磨光
n. 光泽
words.ex: He burnishes the old metal every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都抛光那块旧金属。
words.en: To burnish something means to polish it and make it shine by rubbing it.

words.ex: The candle's flicker lit up the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的闪现照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: If a light or flame flickers, it shines unsteadily.

words.ex: The sun brightens the room in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在早上使房间变亮。
words.en: To make something lighter or more colorful, or to make someone feel happier or more hopeful.

words.tr:
v. 闪烁；隐约闪现
n. 亮光；闪光
words.ex: The sun gleams on the water.
words.ex_cn: 阳光照在水面上，闪闪发亮。
words.en: A gleam is a small, bright light, especially one that shines for a short time.

words.ex: He extinguished the fire with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水把火扑灭了。
words.en: To extinguish a fire or a light means to stop it burning or shining.

words.tr: adj. 着火的；闪耀的；激动的
words.ex: The house was ablaze at night.
words.ex_cn: 那所房子在夜里着火了。
words.en: If something is ablaze, it is burning very fiercely.

words.tr:
v. 闪耀；闪烁
n. 闪烁
words.ex: The stars twinkle in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中闪烁。
words.en: If a star or a light twinkles, it shines with an unsteady light that rapidly and gently changes from bright to faint.

chapters.name: 按意群分类 Word List 35 事物 科学

words.tr: adj. 暂定的；不确定的；试验性的；
words.ex: We made a tentative plan to meet next week.
words.ex_cn: 我们制定了一个下周见面的暂定计划。
words.en: If you make a tentative suggestion or plan, you make it without being sure that it is right or acceptable.

words.ex: The mechanical toy moves with batteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个机械玩具用电池驱动。
words.en: Relating to machines or machinery; operated by or involving a machine or machines.

words.ex: He gave the exact time of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了会议的确切时间。
words.en: If you describe something as exact, you mean that it is precise and accurate in all its details.

words.ex: He is learning theoretical physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习理论物理。
words.en: A theoretical study or explanation is based on or uses the ideas and abstract principles of a subject, rather than the practical aspects or uses of it.

words.ex: He gave a precise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了准确的答案。
words.en: If you give precise information or precise instructions, you give exact details so that there is no confusion about what should be done.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.ex: The teacher showed a specimen of a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一个蝴蝶标本。
words.en: A specimen is a single thing or example of something, especially one that is used to represent the whole group or type.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: A symbol is a shape or design that is used to represent something such as an idea, a quality, or a process.

words.ex: The dove is a symbolic bird of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征性鸟类。
words.en: If you describe an event, action, or procedure as symbolic, you mean that it represents an important change, although it has little practical effect.

words.ex: The watch works with great precision.
words.ex_cn: 这块手表运行得非常精确。
words.en: Precision is the quality of being exact and accurate.

words.ex: The church teaches its doctrine to all members.
words.ex_cn: 教会向所有成员传授它的教义。
words.en: A doctrine is a set of beliefs or principles that are taught or accepted by a particular group, especially in religion or politics.

words.ex: He crossed the threshold of adulthood at 18.
words.ex_cn: 他在18岁时进入了成年的起始点。
words.en: The threshold of something is the point at which it begins or changes.

words.tr: n. 专门知识；专门技能；
words.ex: His expertise in computers helps the team solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机方面的专门知识帮助团队解决问题。
words.en: Expertise is special skill or knowledge that is acquired by training, study, or practice.

words.tr:
n. 研究所；学院；协会；
v. 建立；制定；
words.ex: He works at a research institute.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家研究所工作。
words.en: An institute is an organization set up to do a particular type of work, especially research or teaching. It can also refer to the act of starting something such as a system or an official process.

words.ex: He invented a new machine to clean the house.
words.ex_cn: 他发明了一台新机器来打扫房子。
words.en: To invent something means to design or create it, especially something that has never been made before.

words.ex: The teacher asked us to dissect the poem line by line.
words.ex_cn: 老师让我们逐行仔细分析这首诗。
words.en: To dissect something means to cut it into pieces in order to examine its structure, or to study something in great detail.

words.ex: He contrived to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他设法按时完成了项目。
words.en: If you contrive an event or situation, you succeed in making it happen, often by tricking someone.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.ex: He devised a new way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他设计了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: To devise something means to plan or invent a new way of doing something.

words.tr: n. 测量仪器；规格；评估；
words.ex: The mechanic used a gauge to check the tire pressure.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用一个测量仪器来检查轮胎气压。
words.en: A gauge is a device that measures the amount or quantity of something and shows the measurement in a form that is easy to read, such as a dial or a digital display.

words.ex: The clock shows accurate time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟显示的时间很精确。
words.en: Correct in all details; exact.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

chapters.name: 按意群分类 Word List 35 事物 逻辑

words.tr: adj. 逻辑上的；合乎逻辑的；
words.ex: His argument is logical and easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点合乎逻辑，容易理解。
words.en: In accordance with the principles of logic; reasonable.

words.ex: It rained all day, therefore the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，因此比赛被取消了。
words.en: You use therefore to introduce a logical result or conclusion.

words.ex: It rained all day, hence the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，因此比赛被取消了。
words.en: You use hence to indicate that the statement you are about to make is a consequence of what you have just said.

words.ex: The framework of the house is made of wood.
words.ex_cn: 房子的骨架是木制的。
words.en: A framework is a particular set of rules, ideas, or beliefs which you use in order to deal with problems or to decide what to do.

words.ex: He made a hypothesis that plants grow faster in light.
words.ex_cn: 他提出一个假设，认为植物在光照下长得更快。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

words.ex: His assumption was that the train would be on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的假设是火车会准时。
words.en: An assumption is something that you assume to be the case, even without proof.

words.ex: I presume he will arrive tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假设他明天会到。
words.en: If you presume that something is the case, you think that it is the case, although you are not certain.

words.tr: n. 假定；推定；冒昧；放肆
words.ex: His presumption that he would win surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他以为自己会赢的这种假设让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A presumption is something that is thought to be true because it is likely, although there is no proof.

words.ex: The police found a clue at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了一条线索。
words.en: A clue is an object or piece of information that helps to solve a problem or mystery.

words.ex: He generalized the results from the small group to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他将小群体的结果概括为全体情况。
words.en: If you generalize, you say something that seems to be true in most situations or for most people, but that may not be completely true in all cases.

words.ex: He incurred a fine for speeding.
words.ex_cn: 他因超速而招致了一笔罚款。
words.en: If you incur something unpleasant, it happens to you because of something you have done.

words.ex: I suppose he is late because of the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我认为他因为交通堵塞而迟到了。
words.en: If you suppose that something is true, you believe or imagine that it is true, although you may not have any proof.

words.ex: The premise of his argument is that everyone is equal.
words.ex_cn: 他论点的前提是人人平等。
words.en: A premise is a statement or idea that forms the basis for a reasonable line of argument.

words.ex: He inferred that she was tired from her yawns.
words.ex_cn: 他从她的哈欠推断出她很累。
words.en: If you infer that something is the case, you decide that it is true on the basis of information that you already have.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrates that water boils at 100°C.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验证明水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: To demonstrate means to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence.

words.ex: He likes reading, and furthermore, he writes stories too.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读，而且他还写故事。
words.en: In addition to what has been said; moreover.

words.tr: adv. 自相矛盾地；矛盾地；
words.ex: Paradoxically, he is very quiet, but he speaks the most in class.
words.ex_cn: 自相矛盾地，他非常安静，但在课堂上却说得最多。
words.en: In a way that is contrary to expectations or seemingly contradictory.

words.tr:
v. 假定；要求
n. 假定；假设
words.ex: He postulates that all humans are equal.
words.ex_cn: 他假定所有人都是平等的。
words.en: If you postulate something, you suggest it as the basis for a theory, argument, or calculation.

words.ex: Calling time a thief is a metaphor.
words.ex_cn: 把时间称为小偷是一种隐喻。
words.en: A metaphor is a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable.

chapters.name: 按意群分类 Word List 35 事物 时间

words.tr: adj. 应给的；预期的；到期的；
words.ex: The payment is due tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这笔款项明天应给。
words.en: If something is due at a particular time, it is expected to happen or be done at that time.

words.tr: adj. 匆匆的；粗略的；仓促的
words.ex: He gave the report a cursory look.
words.ex_cn: 他粗略地看了看这份报告。
words.en: A cursory glance or examination is a quick one that is not very thorough.

words.tr: adj. 多年生的；反复出现的；
words.ex: These perennial flowers bloom every year.
words.ex_cn: 这些多年生的花每年都会开花。
words.en: A perennial plant is one that lives for more than two years, often flowering and producing seeds multiple times over its lifespan.

words.ex: He has a chronic cough that lasts for months.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个持续数月的慢性咳嗽。
words.en: A chronic illness or condition lasts for a long time and cannot be cured, but it can usually be controlled.

words.tr: adj. 持久的；恒久的； v. 持续；“last”的现在分词；
words.ex: The friendship between them is lasting.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的友谊是持久的。
words.en: Something that is lasting continues to exist or have an effect for a very long time.

words.tr: adj. 永久的；永恒的；经久不变的
words.ex: The love between them is everlasting.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的爱是永恒的。
words.en: Something that is everlasting lasts forever or for a very long time.

words.tr: adj. 匆忙的；草率的；急躁的
words.ex: He made a hasty decision and regretted it.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个仓促的决定，后来后悔了。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behavior as hasty, you mean that they are acting too quickly, without thinking carefully, often with unwanted results.

words.ex: The joy was transitory, and soon he felt sad again.
words.ex_cn: 这种快乐是暂时的，不久他又感到悲伤了。
words.en: Something that is transitory lasts only for a short time.

words.ex: The joy was transient, like a brief smile.
words.ex_cn: 这种快乐是短暂的，像一个短暂的微笑。
words.en: If you describe something as transient, you mean that it lasts only for a short time.

words.tr: adj. 过时的；废弃的；淘汰的；
words.ex: This phone is obsolete because it doesn't work with new apps.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机已经过时了，因为它不能使用新应用。
words.en: Something that is obsolete is no longer needed because something better has been invented.

words.tr: adj. 即席的；临时的；无准备的；不用讲稿的
words.ex: He gave an extemporaneous speech at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上做了一次即兴演讲。
words.en: spoken or done without preparation

words.ex: The doctor said the patient needs urgent care.
words.ex_cn: 医生说病人需要紧急治疗。
words.en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.

words.tr: adj. 紧迫的； v. 按；“press”的现在分词；
words.ex: The pressing issue is finding clean water.
words.ex_cn: 紧迫的问题是找到干净的水。
words.en: If something is pressing, it needs to be dealt with immediately because it is important or urgent.

words.tr: adj. 即刻的；立即的；紧接的；最近的；
words.ex: He needs immediate help.
words.ex_cn: 他需要即刻的帮助。
words.en: An immediate action, event, or situation happens or exists without any delay.

words.tr: adj. 直截了当的；直率的；坦白的
words.ex: He is forthright about his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他坦率地承认自己的错误。
words.en: If you describe someone as forthright, you admire them because they show clearly and strongly what they think and feel.

words.tr:
adj. 即时的；未经准备的；唐突无礼的
adv. 即时地；未经思索地；随便地
words.ex: He gave an offhand answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个即时的回答。
words.en: If you say something offhand, you say it without checking the details or facts of it beforehand.

words.ex: The temporal change of seasons affects our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 季节的时间变化影响我们的日常生活。
words.en: Relating to time as opposed to eternity; relating to worldly life as opposed to spiritual life.

words.ex: He took a temporary job during summer.
words.ex_cn: 他在暑假期间做了一份短暂的工作。
words.en: Something that is temporary lasts for only a limited time.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.tr:
adj. 无准备的；即兴的；即席的
adv. 无准备地；即兴地；即席地
words.ex: He gave an impromptu speech at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上做了一次即兴演讲。
words.en: An impromptu action is one that you do without planning or organizing it in advance.

words.ex: He makes occasional visits to his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他偶尔去看望祖父母。
words.en: Occasional means happening or done sometimes, but not regularly or often.

words.ex: He is always punctual for class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课总是准时。
words.en: If you are punctual, you do something or arrive somewhere at the right time and are not late.

words.ex: The car stopped in an instantaneous moment.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在瞬间停了下来。
words.en: Happening or done immediately.

words.ex: He failed the test, but subsequent efforts helped him pass.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，但随后的努力让他通过了。
words.en: Following in time or order; succeeding.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.ex: Two events happen concurrently.
words.ex_cn: 两个事件同时发生。
words.en: Happening or existing at the same time.

words.ex: There are only two extant copies of the ancient book.
words.ex_cn: 这本古书现存只有两份。
words.en: If something is extant, it is still in existence, in spite of being very old.

words.ex: Owls are nocturnal animals.
words.ex_cn: 猫头鹰是夜间活动的动物。
words.en: Nocturnal means happening in the night or active at night.

words.ex: He is a former teacher who now works as a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名以前的老师，现在是一名作家。
words.en: Former is used to describe someone who used to have a particular job, position, or role, but no longer has it.

words.ex: He was formerly a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他以前是一名老师。
words.en: Previously; in the past.

words.ex: He read the previous chapter last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了前一章。
words.en: Existing or occurring before in time or order.

words.ex: He worked here previously.
words.ex_cn: 他以前在这里工作。
words.en: At an earlier time or before.

words.ex: The stars seem eternal in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中的星星看起来是永久的。
words.en: If something is eternal, it lasts forever.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.ex: He has an abiding love for music.
words.ex_cn: 他对音乐有着持久的热爱。
words.en: If you have an abiding feeling for someone or something, you have a feeling that lasts for a long time.

words.tr: v. 追溯到；“date”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 过时的；陈旧的；
words.ex: This coin is dated to the year 1500.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币追溯到1500年。
words.en: Something that is dated is old-fashioned and no longer relevant or useful.

words.ex: The book is overdue at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆逾期了。
words.en: If you say that a change or an event is overdue, you mean that you think it should have happened before now.

words.ex: Please tell me beforehand if you can't come.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不能来，请提前告诉我。
words.en: If you do something beforehand, you do it earlier than a particular event.

words.ex: He sings and plays guitar simultaneously.
words.ex_cn: 他一边唱歌一边弹吉他。
words.en: If two or more things happen simultaneously, they happen at exactly the same time.

words.ex: I recently bought a new book.
words.ex_cn: 我最近买了一本新书。
words.en: If something happened recently, it happened only a short time ago.

words.ex: I haven't seen him lately.
words.ex_cn: 我最近没见到他。
words.en: If you say that something has happened lately, you mean that it has happened recently.

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.ex: The Industrial Revolution was a new epoch in history.
words.ex_cn: 工业革命是历史上一个新时代。
words.en: An epoch is a period of time in history or a person's life, typically one marked by notable events or particular characteristics.

words.tr: n. 间歇；插曲；幕间节目
words.ex: He took an interlude to drink water.
words.ex_cn: 他休息了一下喝水。
words.en: An interlude is a short period of time that comes in the middle of something, or a short piece of music, talk, or entertainment that comes between the main parts of a performance or event.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.ex: At this juncture, we need to make a decision.
words.ex_cn: 在这一关键时刻，我们需要做出决定。
words.en: A particular point in events or time, especially one that is critical or decisive.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.tr:
v. 逝去；过去
n. （光阴）逝去
words.ex: Two hours elapsed while he waited for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他等公交车时，两个小时过去了。
words.en: If time elapses, it passes.

words.ex: I concur with your opinion.
words.ex_cn: 我同意你的观点。
words.en: If one person concurs with another person, the first person agrees with the second person.

words.tr: v. 即兴创作；即兴表演；临时准备；
words.ex: He improvise a song on the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他即兴创作了一首钢琴曲。
words.en: If you improvise, you make or do something using whatever you have or without having planned it in advance.

words.ex: The two clocks synchronize automatically.
words.ex_cn: 这两座钟自动同时发生。
words.en: If you synchronize two activities, processes, or movements, or if you synchronize one activity, process, or movement with another, you cause them to happen at the same time and speed as each other.

words.ex: He stopped talking abruptly.
words.ex_cn: 他突然停止了说话。
words.en: Suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: He checks his email periodically.
words.ex_cn: 他周期性地查看他的邮件。
words.en: If something happens periodically, it happens at regular intervals.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: The forest remained pristine and untouched.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林保持原始且未被破坏。
words.en: Something that is pristine is in its original condition and has not been spoiled or damaged.

words.tr: adv. 从而；继续地；循序地
words.ex: He solved the problems sequentially.
words.ex_cn: 他按顺序解决了这些问题。
words.en: In a way that follows a particular order.

chapters.name: 按意群分类 Word List 35 事物 水相关动作

words.tr:
adj. 巡回的；流动的
n. 四处奔波的人；流浪者
words.ex: The itinerant worker moves from town to town for jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这位流动工人为了工作从一个城镇搬到另一个城镇。
words.en: Someone who is itinerant travels from place to place, usually because they have no permanent home or job, or because they are involved in a particular activity that requires this.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 流动；
words.ex: The flow of water in the river is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 河里水的流动非常快。
words.en: To move along or out steadily and continuously in a current or stream.

words.ex: There was a large influx of tourists during the summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天期间涌入了大量游客。
words.en: An influx of people or things is a large number of them arriving somewhere at the same time.

words.tr:
n. 喷雾；
v. 喷洒；
words.ex: She used a spray to clean the window.
words.ex_cn: 她用喷雾清洁了窗户。
words.en: Spray can refer to a liquid that is blown or driven through the air in the form of tiny drops, or to the act of applying such a liquid.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 漂移；
words.ex: The drift of the river carries leaves downstream.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流动将树叶冲向下游。
words.en: If something or someone drifts somewhere, they move there slowly or gradually. As a noun, drift can refer to a slow, gradual movement or change, or the general meaning or intent of something.

words.ex: The price of oil fluctuates every day.
words.ex_cn: 油价每天都在波动。
words.en: To fluctuate means to change or vary frequently and unpredictably.

words.tr: n. 引人注目的人或物；溅污的斑点；
words.ex: The new singer became a splash on the music scene.
words.ex_cn: 这位新歌手成为了音乐界引人注目的人物。
words.en: To cause (a liquid) to scatter in drops or small quantities, especially by striking or moving suddenly; to move or strike so as to cause a liquid to scatter in this way.

words.ex: There was a dip in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额有所下降。
words.en: To dip something means to put it into a liquid and then take it out again.

words.tr:
v. 喷射；迸发；突然加速努力
n. 迸发；喷出；突然一阵
words.ex: The pipe spurted water everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 管道喷出了水，四处都是。
words.en: A spurt is a sudden burst of activity, speed, or growth. It can also refer to a sudden stream of liquid that comes out quickly and forcefully.

words.tr:
n. 喷口；水管；水柱
v. 喷出；滔滔不绝地说
words.ex: The kettle has a small spout for pouring water.
words.ex_cn: 这个水壶有一个小喷口用来倒水。
words.en: If something spouts liquid or fire, or if liquid or fire spout out of something, it comes out very quickly with a lot of force.

words.tr:
v. 缓慢而弯曲地流动；漫步；闲聊
n. 河流的曲折；漫步；迂回曲折的进程
words.ex: The river meanders through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这条河蜿蜒穿过森林。
words.en: To meander means to follow a winding and turning course, often used to describe the way a river flows or the way a person walks without a clear direction.

words.tr:
v. 喷涌；滔滔不绝地说
n. 涌出；喷出
words.ex: Water gushed from the broken pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水从破裂的管道中喷涌而出。
words.en: If someone gushes, they express their admiration or pleasure in an exaggerated way.

words.ex: He immersed the cloth in water.
words.ex_cn: 他把布浸在水里。
words.en: To immerse something or someone means to put them into a liquid so that they are completely covered by it. It can also mean to involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or interest.

words.tr:
n. 溢出；
v. 泛滥；
words.ex: The rain caused an overflow of the river.
words.ex_cn: 雨水导致河水溢出。
words.en: If a liquid or a river overflows, it flows over the edges of the container or place it is in.

words.ex: The teacher tried to infuse confidence into the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师试图向学生注入信心。
words.en: If you infuse a quality into someone or something, you fill them with it. If a quality infuses something, it is present throughout it.

words.ex: The diver submerge to explore the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 潜水员潜水去探索珊瑚礁。
words.en: To submerge something means to put it below the surface of a liquid, especially water. If something submerges, it goes below the surface of a liquid.

words.ex: The teacher imbues her students with confidence.
words.ex_cn: 老师赋予学生信心。
words.en: If someone or something is imbued with a particular quality, feeling, or value, they are filled with it or characterized by it.

words.tr: v. 使浸透；使湿透；使满；使饱和
words.ex: The sponge will saturate if you pour too much water.
words.ex_cn: 如果你倒太多水，海绵会吸满。
words.en: To saturate something means to make it completely wet, or to fill it completely with something so that no more can be added.

words.ex: The flowers exude a sweet smell.
words.ex_cn: 花朵散发出甜美的香味。
words.en: If someone exudes a quality or feeling, or if it exudes, they show that they have it to a great extent.

words.ex: The smell of bread permeate the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 面包的香味弥漫了整个厨房。
words.en: If something permeates a place, it spreads throughout it.

words.ex: The rain dampened the sound of the drums.
words.ex_cn: 雨减弱了鼓声。
words.en: To dampen something means to make it slightly wet, or to make it less strong or intense.

words.ex: She moistened the dry bread with water.
words.ex_cn: 她用水把干面包弄湿了。
words.en: To make something slightly wet.

chapters.name: 按意群分类 Word List 35 事物 物体

words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.tr: n. 工艺；手艺；行业；航空器；
words.ex: The craft of pottery takes years to learn.
words.ex_cn: 陶艺工艺需要多年才能掌握。
words.en: Skill in making things by hand; the skilled practice of a practical occupation; the skilled production of decorative or functional objects.

words.ex: The fishing vessel sailed out at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 那艘渔船在黎明时出海。
words.en: A vessel is a large boat or a container for holding liquids.

words.tr:
n. 紧身褡；腰带；围绕物
v. 以腰带束缚；围绕
words.ex: She wore a girdle to look slimmer.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条束腰裙来显得更苗条。
words.en: A girdle is a piece of women's underwear that fits tightly around the stomach, hips, and bottom.

words.ex: He paints on a canvas with oil colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用油画颜料在帆布上作画。
words.en: A strong, coarse unbleached cloth made from hemp, flax, cotton, or a similar yarn, used to make items such as sails and tents and as a surface for oil painting.

words.tr:
v. 粘附；（随意）放置；忍受；
n. 棍枝；条状物；球棍；
words.ex: The glue makes the paper stick to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水使纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: A stick is a thin branch which has fallen off a tree. If you stick something somewhere, you put it there in a rather casual way.

words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.ex: The company is a legal entity.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是一个法律实体。
words.en: An entity is something that exists separately from other things and has a clear identity of its own.

words.tr:
n. 鞭策；
v. 刺激；
words.ex: The competition served as a spur to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 竞争成了推动他更努力工作的鞭策。
words.en: A spur is something that makes you want to do something or that encourages you to do it. It can also refer to a sharp device worn on the heel of a rider's boot to urge a horse forward.

words.tr: n. 牵狗的链子或皮带；控制；约束
words.ex: He holds the dog's leash tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧握着狗的牵引绳。
words.en: A leash is a rope or a strap that you attach to a dog's collar so that you can control the dog.

words.tr:
n. 长条；条状；
v. 剥去；剥夺；
words.ex: He cut a strip of paper to wrap the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他剪了一条纸来包装礼物。
words.en: To remove a layer from something, or to take off your clothes.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.ex: The door opens on a metal hinge.
words.ex_cn: 这扇门装在一个金属枢纽上。
words.en: A hinge is a piece of metal, wood, or plastic that is used to join two things together so that one of them can swing or move freely.

words.ex: The cat sat on the ledge of the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在窗户的架状突出物上。
words.en: A ledge is a narrow horizontal surface projecting from a wall, cliff, or other surface.

words.ex: The bulk of the students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 大部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: The bulk of something is most of it. The bulk of something is its size, especially when it is very large.

words.tr:
n. 清漆；漆面；光泽面
v. 给…涂上清漆
words.ex: He put varnish on the wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 他在木桌上涂了清漆。
words.en: Varnish is a transparent, hard, protective finish or film primarily used in wood finishing but also for other materials. Varnish is traditionally a combination of a drying oil, a resin, and a thinner or solvent.

words.tr:
n. 用力拉；拖拽；拖船
v. 用力拉；使劲拖；拖拽
words.ex: He gave a strong tug on the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他用力拉了绳子一下。
words.en: If you tug something or tug at it, you give it a quick and usually strong pull.

chapters.name: 按意群分类 Word List 35 事物 效果

words.ex: The signature is null without a date.
words.ex_cn: 没有日期的签名是无效的。
words.en: Having no legal or binding force; completely void or invalid.

words.ex: This coupon is valid until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这张优惠券到下个月都有效。
words.en: If something such as a document or agreement is valid, it is legally acceptable or officially recognized.

words.ex: The ticket is invalid because it expired.
words.ex_cn: 这张票无效，因为它已经过期了。
words.en: If something is invalid, it is not legally or officially acceptable, or it is not based on truth or reason.

words.tr: n. 影响；作用；效果；效应；
words.ex: The new law had a big effect on traffic.
words.ex_cn: 新法律对交通产生了很大影响。
words.en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.

words.ex: This medicine is effective against colds.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对感冒有效。
words.en: Something that is effective works well and produces the results that were intended.

words.ex: He uses an efficient way to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种高效的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: If something or someone is efficient, they are able to do tasks successfully, without wasting time or energy.

words.ex: The outcome of the game was a tie.
words.ex_cn: 比赛的结果是平局。
words.en: The outcome of an activity, process, or situation is the situation that exists at the end of it.

words.tr: n. 无效；虚弱；无能为力；阳萎
words.ex: The new policy showed impotence in solving the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策在解决问题上显得无效。
words.en: The condition of being unable to take effective action; helplessness.

words.tr:
v. 触发；引起；发动；
n. 诱因；触发；
words.ex: The loud noise triggered the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音触发了警报。
words.en: A trigger is a device that activates a mechanism when it is pulled or pressed. It can also refer to something that causes a particular reaction or development.

words.ex: The rain was continuous all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨一整天都在下个不停。
words.en: Something that is continuous happens or exists without stopping or being interrupted.

words.ex: This plan is viable and can be done with little money.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是可行的，而且用很少的钱就能完成。
words.en: If something is viable, it is capable of doing what it is intended to do.

chapters.name: 按意群分类 Word List 35 事物 原因

words.tr: adj. 无故的；无必要的；无偿的；免费的
words.ex: He made a gratuitous comment about her clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的衣服做了毫无必要的评论。
words.en: If you describe something as gratuitous, you mean that it is unnecessary, and often harmful or upsetting.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.tr:
n. 账户；叙述；账目；
v. 占…；说明；
words.ex: I opened a bank account last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周开了一家银行账户。
words.en: An account is a detailed report or description of an event or situation.

words.tr:
n. 原因；理由；理性；
v. 推理；推断；
words.ex: The reason for his absence is sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他缺席的原因是生病。
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.ex: He did it for her sake.
words.ex_cn: 他为了她的缘故做了这件事。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result. You can also say that you do it for something's sake.

words.tr:
v. 导致；引起；
n. 原因；理由；事业；
words.ex: Smoking can cause lung disease.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会导致肺癌。
words.en: The cause of something is what makes it happen or exist.

words.ex: They impute the failure to poor planning.
words.ex_cn: 他们把失败归因于计划不周。
words.en: If you impute something such as blame or a crime to someone, you say that they are responsible for it or that they caused it.

words.tr:
v. 把…归因于；由…引起；
n. 品质；属性；特征；属性；
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

chapters.name: 按意群分类 Word List 35 事物 整体与局部

words.ex: His knowledge of history is superficial.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史的了解是表面的。
words.en: If you describe someone as superficial, you disapprove of them because they do not think deeply, and have little understanding of anything serious or important.

words.ex: He only read the partial report.
words.ex_cn: 他只读了部分报告。
words.en: If you describe something as partial, you mean that it is not complete or whole.

words.ex: The door is partially open.
words.ex_cn: 门部分开着。
words.en: To a limited degree or in a limited manner; not completely.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全面的；总体的；
adv. 总计；大致上；
words.ex: The overall cost is too high.
words.ex_cn: 总成本太高了。
words.en: You use overall to indicate that you are talking about a situation in general or about the whole of something.

words.ex: Honesty is an integral part of a good relationship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是良好关系中不可或缺的一部分。
words.en: Something that is integral is very important or necessary. If something is an integral part of a whole, it is an essential part of that whole.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.ex: He lost his job because of his integrity.
words.ex_cn: 他因为正直而失去了工作。
words.en: Integrity is the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles.

words.tr: adv. 似乎；看似；表面上看；
words.ex: He is seemingly calm, but he is nervous inside.
words.ex_cn: 他似乎很平静，但内心很紧张。
words.en: appearing to be true or real but not necessarily so

words.ex: He ate only a small portion of the cake.
words.ex_cn: 他只吃了一小部分蛋糕。
words.en: A portion of something is a part of it.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: This segment of the book is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常有趣。
words.en: A segment of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: The diamond has many smooth facets.
words.ex_cn: 这颗钻石有许多光滑的小平面。
words.en: A particular aspect or feature of something.

words.ex: One aspect of learning English is practicing speaking.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语的一个方面是练习口语。
words.en: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

words.ex: At this juncture, we need to make a decision.
words.ex_cn: 在这一关键时刻，我们需要做出决定。
words.en: A particular point in events or time, especially one that is critical or decisive.

words.ex: The car stopped at the junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A junction is a place where two or more things, especially roads or railways, come together.

words.ex: A fraction of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 只有一小部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: A fraction is a small part or amount of something.

words.tr:
n. 方面；尊重；尊敬；
v. 遵从；尊重；尊敬；
words.ex: In this respect, the plan is good.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方面，这个计划很好。
words.en: If you respect someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas.

words.ex: A car has many components, like wheels and engines.
words.ex_cn: 汽车有许多部分，比如轮子和发动机。
words.en: A component is a part of a larger whole, especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.ex: The fringe of the forest is full of wildflowers.
words.ex_cn: 森林的边缘长满了野花。
words.en: The outer, marginal, or extreme part of an area, group, or sphere of activity.

chapters.name: 附录二 阅读必备重要词组 第一部分 文章必备词组

words.tr: phrase. 与纹理（或常理、意愿）相反；令人不舒服地；逆着做事
words.ex: He went against the grain and chose to be an artist.
words.ex_cn: 他逆着常理行事，选择了当艺术家。
words.en: If something goes against the grain, it is different from what is usual or natural.

words.tr: 动词短语，指控某人做某事
words.ex: He accused her of stealing his book.
words.ex_cn: 他指责她偷了他的书。
words.en: If you accuse someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you say or tell them that you believe that they did it.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎；差一点；除…外其余都
words.ex: He is all but finished with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎已经做完了作业。
words.en: All but means almost or nearly. It is used to indicate that something is very close to being the case but not completely so.

words.ex: As exams go, this one was easy.
words.ex_cn: 就考试而言，这次很简单。
words.en: As a process or trend develops or progresses; used to indicate a gradual change.

words.tr: phrase. 一般的；普遍；未被捕；详尽
words.ex: The issue is important at large.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题在一般情况下很重要。
words.en: If someone dangerous is at large, they are not in prison or have not been caught. It also means discussing something in a general way without considering details.

words.tr: phrase. 依附于；连接到； attaching oneself or something to a person, object, or place
words.ex: The child attaches to his mother when he is scared.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子害怕时，他会依附于母亲。
words.en: To fasten, join, or connect something to something else.

words.ex: He is accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯于早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you are used to it and it is normal for you.

words.tr: phrase. 被应用于；被实施于；适用于
words.ex: This rule can be applied to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这个规则可以应用于所有学生。
words.en: To be used or relevant in a particular situation or for a particular purpose.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对…感到自在；熟悉并适应于…
words.ex: He is at home in the kitchen, cooking dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在厨房里很自在，正在做晚饭。
words.en: If you are at home in a particular subject, you are very knowledgeable about it.

words.tr: phrase. 献身于；致力于；忠于
words.ex: He is committed to learning English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他致力于每天学习英语。
words.en: If you are committed to something, you are willing to give your time and energy to it because you believe in it or because it is important to you.

words.ex: He is by no means lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对不懒。
words.en: You use 'by no means' to emphasize that something is not true or is definitely not the case.

words.tr: phrase. 凭借自身权利或资格；靠自己的力量或地位
words.ex: He won the championship by his own right.
words.ex_cn: 他凭借自身实力赢得了冠军。
words.en: By one's own right means because of one's own abilities, efforts, or qualifications, rather than because of any connection with someone else.

words.tr: 情不自禁地；不由得（后面接动词原形，表示无法抑制做某事）
words.ex: I can't help but smile when I see my dog.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到我的狗时，我忍不住微笑。
words.en: If you say that you can't help doing something, you mean that you can't prevent yourself from doing it.

words.ex: He cast off the old coat.
words.ex_cn: 他脱下了那件旧外套。
words.en: To get rid of something or someone that is no longer wanted or needed; to untie a boat from the place where it is moored.

words.ex: The restaurant caters to vegetarians.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅迎合素食者的需求。
words.en: To cater to someone or something means to provide them with all the things they need or want.

words.ex: He still clings to his old beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然坚持自己的旧信念。
words.en: To hold on tightly to something or someone, either physically or emotionally, often because of fear, love, or a strong desire.

words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.ex: The number 5 corresponds to the letter E.
words.ex_cn: 数字5对应字母E。
words.en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one is a cause or a result of the other.

words.tr: phrase. 致力于；献身于；全心全意投入于
words.ex: He dedicates himself to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他致力于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: To commit oneself to a particular task or purpose with enthusiasm and determination.

words.ex: The storm deprived him of his power.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴使他失去了电力。
words.en: To take something away from someone or something; to prevent someone from having something.

words.ex: People from every walk of life came to the festival.
words.ex_cn: 来自各行各业的人都来参加了这个节日。
words.en: People from all types of jobs and social positions.

words.tr: phrase. 首要地位；第一等级；最高级别
words.ex: He got first rank in the math competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学竞赛中获得了第一名。
words.en: The highest or most important position in a hierarchy or competition.

words.tr: phrase. 跟随某人的领导；照某人的做法去做
words.ex: He decided to follow his friend's lead and study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他决定跟随朋友的脚步，学习工程。
words.en: To follow someone's lead means to do as they do or to follow their example in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 从某人的立场或观点来看
words.ex: From my standpoint, this plan is too risky.
words.ex_cn: 从我的角度来看，这个计划太冒险了。
words.en: From one's personal perspective, opinion, or point of view.

words.tr: phrase. 从某人的角度看；在某人看来
words.ex: From my point of view, this movie is boring.
words.ex_cn: 从我的角度看，这部电影很无聊。
words.en: Used to indicate that the following statement is based on the perspective or opinion of a particular person.

words.ex: He wants to get rid of the old chair.
words.ex_cn: 他想扔掉那把旧椅子。
words.en: To dispose of or remove something unwanted or undesirable.

words.tr: phrase. 合调的；和谐的；一致的；协调的
words.ex: The guitar is in tune.
words.ex_cn: 这把吉他调音准确。
words.en: If someone is in tune with something, they understand it well or are in agreement with it.

words.ex: The old rules give way to new ones.
words.ex_cn: 旧规则让位于新规则。
words.en: If something gives way to something else, it is replaced by it.

words.tr: phrase. 啃食；吃草（指动物吃地上的草或其他植物）
words.ex: The cows graze on grass near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 牛在山边吃草。
words.en: To feed on growing grass or herbage, as cattle, sheep, etc.

words.ex: They have music in common.
words.ex_cn: 他们有共同的爱好是音乐。
words.en: If two or more people or things have something in common, they share the same interests or experiences, or have similar characteristics.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；抑制；使退缩；隐瞒
words.ex: He tried to hold back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住眼泪。
words.en: To hold back means to prevent someone or something from moving forward or making progress, or to keep something secret or not express your feelings.

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.ex: He is in favor of eating vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他赞成吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you are in favor of something, you support it or agree with it.

words.tr: phrase. 与...协调一致；与...和谐
words.ex: The painting is in harmony with the room's colors.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画与房间的颜色相协调。
words.en: If one thing is in harmony with another, the first thing suits the second or they seem right together.

words.tr: phrase. 高速运转地；全力以赴地；处于高效率状态
words.ex: The car is running in high gear.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以高速挡行驶。
words.en: If something is in high gear, it is operating at its maximum level of efficiency or speed.

words.tr: phrase. 凭自身的能力或资格；独立地；本身
words.ex: She is a successful artist in her own right.
words.ex_cn: 她本身就是一个成功的艺术家。
words.en: If someone is a particular kind of person in their own right, they are that kind of person because of their own efforts, talents, or qualities, and not because of their connection with someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 在很大程度上；相当程度上
words.ex: He improved his grades in significant measure by studying every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天学习，在很大程度上提高了成绩。
words.en: To a large extent; largely.

words.tr: phrase. 在最严格的意义上；严格说来
words.ex: In the strictest sense, water is H2O.
words.ex_cn: 严格来说，水就是H2O。
words.en: In the most precise or exact meaning of a word or phrase.

words.tr: phrase. 与…一致；与…相符；与…和谐
words.ex: His story does not jibe with the facts.
words.ex_cn: 他的说法与事实不符。
words.en: To be in agreement with; to match or correspond to something.

words.tr: phrase. 与…保持同步；跟上…的最新发展
words.ex: He tries to keep abreast with new technology.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上新技术的发展。
words.en: To stay informed about the latest developments or trends in a particular field or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 向……致敬；向……表示敬意；向……献礼
words.ex: They made a tribute to their teacher after she retired.
words.ex_cn: 他们在老师退休后向她致敬。
words.en: To express admiration, respect, or honor for someone or something, often publicly.

words.tr: phrase. 对…产生影响；给…留下深刻印象
words.ex: Her speech made an impact on the audience.
words.ex_cn: 她的演讲对观众产生了影响。
words.en: To have a strong effect or influence on someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 前往；朝…走去；费力地走到
words.ex: He makes his way to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去学校。
words.en: To go or travel towards a particular place or in a particular direction.

words.tr: phrase. 让路给；为…腾出空间；给…让位
words.ex: The old building was torn down to make way for a new park.
words.ex_cn: 旧建筑被拆除了，为新公园让路。
words.en: If you make way for someone or something, you move aside so that they can pass or so that there is space for them.

words.ex: Notwithstanding the rain, they went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 虽然下着雨，他们还是去散步了。
words.en: In spite of; although.

words.tr: phrase. 大体上；基本上；总的来说
words.ex: On the whole, the movie was good.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，这部电影不错。
words.en: You use on the whole to indicate that what you are saying is true in general but may not be true in every case, or that you are giving a general opinion or summary of something.

words.ex: I don't mind helping, only that I'm busy now.
words.ex_cn: 我不介意帮忙，只是我现在很忙。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is the only thing that matters or is true.

words.tr: phrase. 扮演一个角色；参与；在……中起作用
words.ex: He plays a part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校的戏剧中扮演一个角色。
words.en: To have a role or influence in something.

words.ex: The judge will preside over the trial tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 法官明天将主持审判。
words.en: To preside over a meeting or event means to be in charge of it and to ensure that it is conducted in an orderly and efficient manner.

words.ex: He left home prior to sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 他在日出前离开了家。
words.en: Before a particular time or event.

words.tr: v. 提供；供应；“provide”的过去式和过去分词； conj. 如果；假如；在…条件下；
words.ex: The school provides free lunch to students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If a particular condition is true or if a particular event happens, then another condition will be true or another event will happen.

words.ex: The new law will put an end to pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律将结束污染。
words.en: To cause something to stop or to finish something.

words.ex: He went for a walk regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去散步了。
words.en: Without taking into account; without being affected by.

words.ex: We are short of money to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 我们缺钱买食物。
words.en: If you are short of something, you do not have enough of it. If something is short of a place, it is not as far as that place.

words.tr: phrase. 迅速成长；迅速上升；猛增
words.ex: The prices shoot up during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 假期期间，价格迅速上涨。
words.en: To increase rapidly in size, amount, or intensity; to inject a drug.

words.tr: phrase. 服从；容易遭受；受制于
words.ex: All students are subject to the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都必须服从校规。
words.en: Likely to be affected by or to experience something.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠……维持生活；仅靠……生存
words.ex: They subsist on rice and vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他们靠米饭和蔬菜维持生活。
words.en: To subsist on something means to maintain or support oneself at a minimal level on it, especially in difficult conditions.

words.ex: He took advantage of the free tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了免费的票。
words.en: To use a particular situation to do or get what you want.

words.tr: phrase. 呈现；承担；接受；较量；雇用
words.ex: The sky takes on a pink color at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出粉红色。
words.en: To undertake or begin to deal with a task or responsibility; to hire someone; to acquire a particular appearance or quality.

words.ex: He takes his health for granted.
words.ex_cn: 他把健康视为理所当然。
words.en: If you take something for granted, you believe it to be true or accept it as normal or without questioning it.

words.tr: phrase. （尤指体重）达到（某数量）；秤上显示为……
words.ex: He tips the scale at 80 kilograms.
words.ex_cn: 他体重80公斤。
words.en: To cause the scale to tilt; to reach a certain weight.

words.tr: phrase. 极端地；非常；到极点
words.ex: He works to the extreme to finish his project.
words.ex_cn: 他极端地努力完成他的项目。
words.en: To the greatest possible degree; extremely.

words.tr: phrase. 达到…的程度；近乎…的地步
words.ex: He worked to the point of exhaustion.
words.ex_cn: 他工作到筋疲力尽。
words.en: To the extent or degree of something, often implying reaching a limit or extreme.

words.tr: phrase. 达到……的程度；在……范围内
words.ex: He was tired to the extent of falling asleep at his desk.
words.ex_cn: 他累到在办公桌上睡着了。
words.en: To the degree or limit that something happens or is true.

words.tr: phrase. 多达；直到；在于…；能胜任
words.ex: The box can hold up to ten books.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子最多能放十本书。
words.en: used to say that something is the responsibility of someone or that someone has the ability to decide something

words.ex: The new technology will usher in a better future.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术将开启一个更美好的未来。
words.en: To usher in something means to be at the start of a new period, especially one that involves important changes or improvements.

words.ex: He wiped out the board with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布把板擦掉了。
words.en: To completely destroy, remove, or eliminate something or someone.

words.ex: We need to decide with respect to the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要考虑到天气来做出决定。
words.en: Regarding or concerning something.

chapters.name: 附录二 阅读必备重要词组 第二部分 阅读常考词组

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.ex: He is ahead of his classmates in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上比同学领先。
words.en: In front of or before something in time or space.

words.tr: phrase. 由于…的结果；起因；经；因
words.ex: He was late as a result of the bus breaking down.
words.ex_cn: 由于公交车坏了，他迟到了。
words.en: Because of something that has happened.

words.tr: 短语，作为……的替代品；代替……
words.ex: He used honey as a substitute for sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他用蜂蜜代替糖。
words.en: In place of something else; as an alternative to.

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.tr: phrase. 把……归因于；认为……是由于
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 充满（危险、困难或忧虑）的；伴有……的
words.ex_cn: 这次旅程充满了危险。
words.en: If a situation or action is fraught with problems or risks, it is filled with them.

words.ex: The toy will break apart if you pull it hard.
words.ex_cn: 如果你用力拉，玩具会散开。
words.en: To separate into parts or pieces, often suddenly or violently.

words.ex: The fire broke out in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 火在厨房里突然烧了起来。
words.en: If something such as war, fighting, or disease breaks out, it begins suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 打碎；分裂；解体；结束；期终放假
words.ex: He broke up the ice with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把冰打碎了。
words.en: To end a relationship or to disintegrate into pieces.

words.ex: Hard work can bring about success.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作可以带来成功。
words.en: To cause something to happen.

words.ex: The factory makes cheese, and whey is a by-product.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂生产奶酪，乳清是副产品。
words.en: A by-product is something that is produced as a result of making something else, or something unexpected that happens as a result of something.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；号召；要求；接（人）
words.ex: The situation calls for immediate action.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况需要立即采取行动。
words.en: If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr: phrase. 取消；转移；叫走；依次叫名
words.ex: They decided to call off the meeting because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为风暴决定取消会议。
words.en: To cancel or abandon something that was planned.

words.ex: He still clings to his old beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然坚持自己的旧信念。
words.en: To hold on tightly to something or someone, either physically or emotionally, often because of fear, love, or a strong desire.

words.ex: He came down with the bill after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭后付了账单。
words.en: If you come down with an illness, you catch it or start to suffer from it.

words.tr: phrase. 到达；显现；实现；成功地完成；（健康）恢复；渡过
words.ex: The package will come through tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 包裹明天会到达。
words.en: To successfully deal with a difficult situation or to do what is needed or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 苏醒；到达；总计；突然想起
words.ex: He came to after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If someone comes to, they regain consciousness after being unconscious. It can also mean to reach a particular state or condition, or to be involved in something.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.ex: I can count on my brother to help me.
words.ex_cn: 我可以依靠我哥哥帮我。
words.en: If you count on someone or something, you rely on them to support you or help you.

words.ex: The price is $50, couple with free shipping.
words.ex_cn: 价格是50美元，再加上免费送货。
words.en: To combine or link something with something else, especially in a way that enhances or complements it.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.tr: phrase. 献身于； 把...专用于；致力于…
words.ex: He devotes to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他献身于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: To give all or a large part of one's time or resources to (a person, activity, or cause).

words.tr: phrase. 消除；终止；废除；杀死；干掉
words.ex: They want to do away with the old rules.
words.ex_cn: 他们想废除旧规则。
words.en: To do away with something means to get rid of it or to stop using it.

words.tr: phrase. 从…得到；从…召集或选择
words.ex: He draws from his experience to solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他从自己的经验中汲取灵感来解决问题。
words.en: To take or obtain something from a particular source.

words.tr: phrase. 从…中驱赶出去；把…赶出
words.ex: The loud noise drove the birds out of the trees.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音把鸟儿从树上驱赶了出去。
words.en: To force someone or something to leave a place or position.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐减少并消失；渐渐消散
words.ex: The water in the cup dwindles away slowly.
words.ex_cn: 杯子里的水慢慢变少了。
words.en: To gradually decrease in size, amount, or strength until little remains.

words.ex: He is easily moved by sad movies.
words.ex_cn: 他很容易被悲伤的电影打动。
words.en: Capable of being moved or rearranged with little effort.

words.ex: He excels in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面很出色。
words.en: If someone excels in something, they are very good at doing it.

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.ex: Can you explain this math problem?
words.ex_cn: 你能解释一下这个数学问题吗？
words.en: To make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it.

words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子前面。
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.ex: The preceding chapter explains the basics.
words.ex_cn: 前一章解释了基础知识。
words.en: Existing or coming before something else in time, order, or importance.

words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.ex: He used honey in place of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他用蜂蜜代替了糖。
words.en: Instead of someone or something else.

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.tr: phrase. 证明；证实；作证说明
words.ex: He testified to the truth of what happened.
words.ex_cn: 他证明了所发生事情的真实性。
words.en: To testify to something means to provide evidence or proof of it, especially in a legal context.

words.ex: The room is full of toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间充满了玩具。
words.en: Containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.

words.tr: phrase. 控告，指控（某人犯有某种罪行）；赋予（某人）责任或任务
words.ex: The police charged him with stealing.
words.ex_cn: 警察指控他偷窃。
words.en: If someone is charged with a crime, they are formally accused of it in a court of law.

words.tr:
v. 分开；分裂；
n. 划分；分歧；
words.ex: The tree split in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那棵树在风暴中裂开了。
words.en: If something splits or if you split it, it is divided into two or more parts.

words.ex: He begins his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始做作业。
words.en: To start doing something; to take the first step into a process or activity.

words.tr:
adj. 分开的；分离的；单独的；
v. 分离；隔离；
words.ex: They live in separate houses.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在分开的房子里。
words.en: To cause to move or be apart; to divide or keep apart.

words.tr:
v. 生产；制造；导致；引起；生育；出示；
n. 农产品；
words.ex: The farm produces fresh vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每天生产新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: To produce something means to make, create, or manufacture it, often in large quantities. It can also refer to the act of causing something to happen or exist.

words.tr:
v. 导致；引起；
n. 原因；理由；事业；
words.ex: Smoking can cause lung disease.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会导致肺癌。
words.en: The cause of something is what makes it happen or exist.

words.ex: He will introduce his friend to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他将向全班介绍他的朋友。
words.en: If you introduce someone, you tell someone else their name so that they can know each other.

words.ex: The cheese is a derivative of milk.
words.ex_cn: 这种奶酪是牛奶的派生物。
words.en: A derivative is something which has been developed or obtained from something else.

words.ex: This job requires patience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要耐心。
words.en: If you require something, you need it or want it.

words.ex: He will cancel the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会取消会议。
words.en: If you cancel something that has been arranged, you stop it from happening. If you cancel an order for goods or services, you tell the person or organization supplying them that you no longer wish to receive them.

words.tr: phrase. v. 紧紧抓住；坚持（信念、原则等）
words.ex: Hold fast to your dreams, no matter how hard life gets.
words.ex_cn: 无论生活多么艰难，都要紧紧抓住你的梦想。
words.en: To continue to believe in or adhere to an idea, principle, or course of action despite difficulties or opposition.

words.tr: phrase. 粘附；坚持；紧跟；忠于
words.ex: The glue will stick the paper to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水会把纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: If you stick to a promise, agreement, decision, or principle, you do what you said you would do, or do not change your mind.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.tr: v. “write”的过去分词；写作；书写； adj. 书面的；
words.ex: The letter was written by hand.
words.ex_cn: 这封信是手写的。
words.en: Something that is written has been recorded in writing rather than spoken.

words.ex: He regained consciousness after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后恢复了意识。
words.en: To regain consciousness means to become conscious again after being unconscious.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.ex: He copes with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To cope with a problem or task means to deal with it successfully.

words.ex: He dedicates his time to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他致力于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: If you dedicate yourself to something, you give all your attention and effort to it.

words.ex: He specializes in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他专攻计算机科学。
words.en: To concentrate on and become expert in a particular subject or skill.

words.ex: He wants to get rid of the old chair.
words.ex_cn: 他想扔掉那把旧椅子。
words.en: To dispose of or remove something unwanted or undesirable.

words.ex: I disagree with him about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 我不同意他对这部电影的看法。
words.en: To have or express a different opinion from someone else; to not agree with someone or something.

words.ex: The storm took from the harvest this year.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴减损了今年的收成。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to subtract something from a total.

words.tr: phrase. 强行赶出；迫使离开；挤走
words.ex: They force out the old manager.
words.ex_cn: 他们把老经理赶走了。
words.en: To compel someone to leave a place or position, often against their will.

words.tr: phrase. + v. 最终消失；最后不见
words.ex: The clouds will eventually disappear in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 云朵最终会在阳光下消失。
words.en: To cease to be visible or to exist after a period of time.

words.ex: This portable charger works well on trips.
words.ex_cn: 这个便携式充电器在旅行时很好用。
words.en: Capable of being carried or moved about with ease.

words.tr: adj. 杰出的；尚未处理的；
words.ex: He is an outstanding student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名杰出的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

words.ex: Please remove from the table.
words.ex_cn: 请把东西从桌子上移开。
words.en: To take something away from a place or person.

words.tr: phrase. 厌烦的；受够了的；极度不满的
words.ex: I am fed up with doing the same work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我厌倦了每天做同样的工作。
words.en: If you are fed up, you are unhappy, bored, or tired of something, especially something that you have been experiencing for a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；弄明白；解决；想出
words.ex: I can't figure out the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我算不出答案。
words.en: To understand or solve something by thinking about it.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents from time to time.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If you do something from time to time, you do it occasionally but not regularly.

words.ex: He got over his cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周康复了。
words.en: To recover from something, such as an illness or a shock; to overcome a problem or difficulty.

words.ex: He will not give in to the bully.
words.ex_cn: 他不会向欺凌者屈服。
words.en: To agree to something that you had been opposing, especially because someone has forced or persuaded you to.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.ex: The teacher will hand out the papers now.
words.ex_cn: 老师现在会分发试卷。
words.en: To distribute something to a group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；支撑；继续下去；推举；阻挡；拦截；持械抢劫
words.ex: He held up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To hold something up means to keep it in a high position so that it does not fall or to support it. It can also mean to delay or stop the progress of something or someone, or to rob someone using violence or the threat of violence.

words.ex: She looks after her little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To take care of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 察看；检查；翻阅；原谅；从...上面看
words.ex: He will look over his homework before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉前会检查一下作业。
words.en: To examine or inspect something quickly or casually.

words.ex: We don't have enough food, so we will make do with what we have.
words.ex_cn: 我们没有足够的食物，所以只能将就着用现有的。
words.en: If you make do with something, you use or have it instead of something else that you do not have, although it is not as good.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
